tei:div.tei:p: (1na)dus gsum mkhyen pa'i zhus lan bzhugs so//

"$ (1ba)bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma rin po che la phyis kho bos gdams ngag cig zhus nas/ bsgoms pas zhag 'ga' lon pa dang gang nas byung cha med pa'i gsal sing nge ba'i nyams shig byung zhus pas/ rin po che'i zhal nas/ de dkar po cig thub bya ba yin pas/ sang gnangs dang phyis rtag tu de tsug 'ong ba yin pas rgyab yol dro bar gyis/ gos srab par gyis la sgoms dang*/ shes pa bkol du btub par 'dug gis gsung*/ de nas bza' med nas bza' 'tshol du phyin pas/ zla ba gsum du ma mjal/ de nas 'ol ka srub na bzhugs nas 'dug /der phyin nas zhag 'ga' bsgoms pas/ bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams gsha' ma zhig byung nas/ zhus pas/ hu re mdzad nas da lta sgom bzang bar 'dug ste/ de rtsa ba gang nas byung gsung*/ ma shes byas pas 'o na da rung de ka tsug bsgom dgos pa yin gsung*/ yang zhag 'ga' bsgoms pas bde gsal de 'gro ba'i lam kun tu yang de sems yin snyam (2na)pa zhig byung*/ rnam rtog yang sems su shes pa bag re yong bar 'dug zhus pas/ rin po che'i zhal nas/ bde gsal dang drod la sogs pa ci byung yang yun mi ring bar yang yang bsgom pa yin gsung*/ yang zhag 'ga' re bsgoms pas/ lte ba'i 'og tu tsha ba mi bzod pa zhig byung zhus pas/ rin po che'i zhal nas rlung bag re tshud par 'dug ste/ rtsa nang du rlung byung bas der rnam rtog zhugs pa yin pas zhag 'ga' gtum mo rang ma bsgom gsung*/ ma bsgoms kyang gtum mo rang dran pa tsam gyis kyang de tsug byung zhus pas/ rin po che'i zhal nas de thams cad rnam rtog yin pas lte ba man chad du 'jam rlung bzung la/ phyag rgya chen po rang bsgom/ rlung rang 'gror thong gsung*/ yang thebs cig bsgom bya sgom byed kyi snang grags 'di/ ci yang ma mthong bar rig pa gsal sing nge ba zhig byung zhus pas/ rin po che'i zhal nas/ lkug pas rmi lam rmis pa dang*/ gzhon nu ma'i bde ba lta bu zer ba ste/

bshad pas mi shes (2ba)pa yod/ khyod rang bsgom zhig ci shes pa byed pa yin pas/ dri rgyu ma bde ba ci byung yang mtshams dam yang shog gsung*/ yang nub cig rmi lam na/ dge slong gcig gis sngar ma thos pa'i chos cig bshad pa rmis/ de gsal ba zhig byung zhus pas/ rin po che'i zhal nas/ de la khyod dga' bar 'dug gam gsung*/ 'dug byas pas bka' bkyon drag po zhig mdzad nas/ kho de mngon sum du yang cho 'phrul sna tshogs byung ba las/ de thams cad sgyu mar shes na lam du 'gro ba yin/ bden par bzung na bar chad yin pas/ sems la ci byung ba thams cad bzang yang dang du mi blang*/ ngan pa byung yang mi spang*/ de thams cad gnyis med du shes par byed pa yin/ de ltar ma shes na mi 'dod pa zhig byung ba'i dus su/ de bar chad du 'gro ba yin gsung*/ yang gtum mo bsgoms pas drod skyes pa'i dus su/ nyon mongs pa'i 'ching bar song zhus pas/ rin po che'i zhal nas/ de byang sems rgyas pa yin pas/ de bde bar 'khyer ba yin/ rdo rje nor bu nas yar bkram nas/ spyi bo man chad bde ltem ltem song bar bsgom pa yin/ de nas mar la thig le 'chor 'chor 'dra na/ rang gi spyi bor ma dmar ser zhig bsam/ rang gi mig gnyis lte bar bsams nas/ de la yar blta bar bsam pa yin/ de la yang shes pa ma yengs bde gsal du 'dug pa la/ rnam rtog re byung yang sems su shes pa 'byung bas/ rnam rtog de 'phror ma btub/ snang grags sems su shes te yang 'phror ma btub zhus pas/ rin po che'i zhal nas rnal 'byor ma ga gā ngha ras/ rnal 'byor pa badz+ra shrī la/ rigs kyi bu yul la ma blta sems la ltos// bya ba ma mang zhe 'dod kun dang phrol// nyam nga ma byed dogs pas bdag ma 'ching*// sems ni (3na)gang dga' nyid du thong las thong*// zhes gsungs pas/ badz+ra shrīs grub pa thob skad/ gnyis med shes pa chu dang 'o ma 'dres pa 'dra// nyams myong sprin ltar ji ltar 'gyur yang rung*// rnal 'byor shes pa glang po lta bur gang rtogs pa// nam mkha' bzhin du kun la khyab pa yin// rig pa rnam rtog phyir 'brang ma shor bar// rnam rtog ci byung sems su shes par gyis// bya ba yin pas rig pa gsal sing nge ba/

nam mkha' bzhin du sems su shes dgos pa yin/ thams cad sems su shes pa byung ba la/ mdzo bo byang du song yang sna thag lag par yod bya ba yin/ rnam rtog sprin dang 'dra ba yin/ res ci tsug yod/ res gang 'dra yong ma nges/ de thams cad nyams bya ba yin/ ci byung yang thams cad sems su shes par gyis la sgoms gsung*/ yang nga'i rig pa gsal sing nge 'dug pa ste/ res srid pa'i rtse mo man chad rlung gi dkyil 'khor yan chad pa thams cad rang gi sems ma yin pa ci yang mi 'dug snyam pa zhig byung zhus pas/ kyai rdo rje las ngo bo/ gzugs med mthong ba po yang med// sgra med thos pa po yang med// dri med snom pa po yang med// ro med myong ba po yang med// ces pa dgyes pa rdo rje'i lung las gsungs pas/ ji ltar chu la chu bzhag dang*// ji ltar mar la mar bzhag bzhin// bya ba yin pas lus sems khong glod la zhog /srid pa gsum man chad/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor yan chad rang rig pa sems yin/ rang bzhin grub pa med gsung*/ yang 'od gsal bya ba de chos thams cad sems su shes pa la zer ba lags sam zhus pas kun de tsug yin/ go tsa na 'o skol la rang gi rig pa de gsal la ma 'gags pa/ skye 'gag med pa de 'od gsal bya ba (3ba)yin gsung*/ yang gcig por sdod dus su dgod snying kha nas 'dod/ gnyid gung du dgod pa 'ong bas mi'i rtsar nyal mi btub par 'dug zhus pas/ de bde ba rgyas pa yin pas bzang ba yin gsung*/ yang nyin gcig thabs lam zhu byas pas/ de ko kun tu bshad pa des chog /ma bsgoms na bar do gdams ngag shes kyang mi phan/ khyed rang yang da rung bsgom nus na de bskyangs pas chog par 'dug /bar do'i dus tshod du yang bsgom 'od gsal de'i rjes su 'brang*/ rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal gyis sngun bsu ba yin gsung*/ bsgom nus na des chog gam zhus pas/ rin po che'i zhal nas dkar po gcig thub de la byed pa yin/

nga la yang de las med gsung*/ 'o na nga'i bde ba gsal sing nge 'dug pa de/ res yengs thabs su 'byung*/ nyin la gsal mtshan la mi gsal zhus pas/ rin po che'i zhal nas khyod la da rung skyon gcig 'dug pa/ gsal na dga' mi gsal na mi dga' ba'i skyon gcig 'dug /de tsug byed pa min/ rang gi rig pa de gsal sing nge bzhag nas rnam rtog gi phyir mi 'brang rnam rtog ci byung yang sems su shes/ sems skye med shes par byed pa yin/ sems la ci byung yang gnyis med du shes dgos pa yin/ nyin la gsal ba de rig pa dang snang ba 'dres pa yin/ nub mo yang ci yang ma yin pa'i bde sing nge ba zhig yod pa yin/ mi mang sar kha rog sdod la sgoms/ 'gro ba'i lam kun tu yang bsgom byung ngam ltos gsung*/ de gnyis ka la khyad med pa 'ong bar 'dug zhus pas/ 'o de yin gsung*/ sngar ngas sdig pa bag tsam 'phra ba zhig byas/ las 'bras bsgom pa'i dus su de dran tsam gyis sdug bsngal che bar byung zhus pas/ rin po che'i zhal nas de kun thams cad (4na)stong nyid thun cig gis 'dag pa yin/ dper na sog ma phung po zhig la me stag cig btab pas na thams cad dngos med la 'gro /de bzhin du snga ma'i sdig pa byas pa phra mo de rnam rtog yin/ sems yin sems de skye med du byas pas 'dag pa yin gsung*/ yang snang grags thams cad sems yin par 'dug /gzhan logs na med snyam pa zhig byung*/ sems kyi ngo bo de la bltas pas thug pa mi 'dug /nam mkha' la mdung skor ba bzhin du byung zhus pas/ rin po che'i zhal nas/ sems 'di rnam rtog gi phyir ma 'brang bar bcas bcos ma byed par rang dag rang gsal du zhog la/ rnam rtog la mi 'thad pa ci byung yang*/ mi dga' ba ma byed par de rang la ltos dang*/ de la kha dog med/ dbyibs med/ ngos bzung med/ de rig pa rang gi ngo bo yin pas/ gsal la ma 'gag pa de rang yin gsung*/ 'o na bde gsal mi rtog pa'i dus su yun mi ring gsung ba zhus pas/

rin po che'i zhal nas de ma yin byas pa la/ da res 'di gsal mi zer lus bde ba che la gsal la mi rtog pa'i dus su der yun ring na/ shes pa lus kyi bde ba la yengs nas/ rlung ba spu'i bu ga nas phar shor nas/ phyis grang ba can du 'gro ba yin/ dge bshes spyan snga ba'i lo rgyus kyang gsung*/ yang nga la bde gsal mi rtog pa gsum las gsal ba shas che/ skabs su nga'i shes pa de yengs na dngos po phyi nang 'dres nas/ nam phyed ci yang mi dran pa zhig byung zhus pas/ rin po che'i zhal nas rig pa gsal sing nge 'dug pa de/ rtsa ba sems yin pas de ma shor bar gyis la/ dran tshad ci byung yang rtsa ba sems su gyis/ bcas bcos ma byed rtog dpyod ma byed par/ lus sems khong glod la glen sgom rang (4ba)gyis dang*/ de yang chu ma rnyogs na dwangs pa'i rang bzhin/ sems ma bslad na gsal ba'i rang bzhin bya ba yin pas/ rtog dpyod byas bcas bcos byas/ chags sdang byas na mi gsal du 'gro ba yin gsung*/ yang thengs cig nga'i bde ba de chung du song*/ gsal ba dang mi rtog pa mnyam par 'dug zhus pas/ ci yang mi nyes sngar bde ba che dus su/ bsgom yun ring bas yal ba yin gsung*/ yang thengs cig gnyid thung gcig gi nang du yang thams cad btsir btub pa cig byung*/ de'i dus su yi dwags kyi sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa byung zhus pas/ rin po che'i zhal nas de rlung skyon yin te 'ong*/ skyon thams cad 'dis sel ba yin gsungs nas/ 'khrul 'khor zab pa zhig bstan pa des sel/ nang cig spyan sngar 'bod du byung nas phyin pa dang*/ rin po che'i zhal nas 'o skol gnyis rlung gis khyer bas/ khyod kyis chos nyan nas bshad pa la gang gis kyang de ma shes/ khyod kyis chos gsha' ma zhig da gzod rnyed pa yin gsung*/ sngar gyi yi dwags kyi snang ba byung ba de 'dod pa yin te/ gzhan gang nas kyang ma byung rang gi sems las byung ba yin/

rang sems de skye med chos sku yin pas de bzhin du sgoms gsung*/ yang 'od gsal ngo shes pa de zhabs su tim tim 'gro ba 'dra ba zhig byung*/ de'i dus su rtog pa gcig kyang mi 'phro ba 'dra ba zhig byung zhus pas/ rlung bag re a ba dhū tir tshud pa yin gtan du de mi 'ong gsung*/ yang thengs cig sa'i gting du 'dzul ba zhig rmis/ nyams rang yang de tsug byung zhus pas/ rin po che'i zhal nas/ 'o cag rnam rtog lam du 'khyer ba la/ rnam rtog chung chung sems su shes pas mi 'ong*/ 'o na ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal lam/ mer mchongs pa'am/ chur mchongs pa'am (5na)sdug bsngal chen po zhig nyams su myong ba zhig rmis pa'am/ nyams su myong ba zhig 'byung na/ de la 'dod thog tu byed lam du byed pa yin/ chos gsha' ma zhig gzod yong ba yin/ de la nan chags cher gyis la/ da lta'i sdug bsngal de la bltas pas kha dog med dbyibs med/ de thams cad rang sems las ma 'das/ thams cad sems yin sems skye med yin pas de tsug sgom dgos pa yin/ yang zhag 'ga' bsgoms pas nyams la dmyal ba'i snang ba byung te/ sems su shes pa byung zhus pas/ rin po che'i zhal nas/ spyir theg pa chen po gsang sngags 'di bden pa zab pa yin/ dmyal ba nyan thos pa ltar bden bzhin pa med/ de'i yul med sems kyi 'khrul snang yin pas/ rnam rtog lam du 'khyer ba 'di las zab pa med pas/ da rung dmyal ba'i nyams byung ba dang*/ de sems su shes par gyis la sems skye med du shes par gyis/ de la goms pas sang gnangs phyis bar dor dmyal ba'i snang ba byung yang sems su shes pas dar gyi pho long brdabs pa tsam zhig byung*/ slob dpon tog rtse pa'i zhal nas/ shes pa 'di la brten nas ni// bag chags ngan pa'i snang ba yis// dmyal ba dag tu skye srid kyang*// dmyal ba rang yang bde ba can// bya ba'i don yang de yin gsung*// yang skabs shig na sngon rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i sar nad cig byung*/

da lta de'i thad sor skrangs nas 'dug /tshangs bug kyang skrangs/ zas kyang mi 'dod pa cig byung zhus pas/ rin po che'i zhal nas/ 'byung ba'i nad kyang bag re yin/ sgom chen pa'i nad phal cher chos bsam pa dang sgom pa ma lags pa rnam rtog nad du song ba yin/ gnyis med bsgoms (5ba)pas gnyis su shor bya ba yin gsung*/ nad thams cad re dwogs rang yin/ re bas 'phung dogs pas 'gag bya ba yin pas nad de rang la ltos dang*/ kha dog med dbyibs med thams cad sems yin pas/ nar song gis dogs pa'i dogs pa ma byed/ sos su re ba ma byed/ 'dis go bcad pa yin snyam du bya gsung*/ yang mnyam bzhag la gsal sing nge 'dug /de'i dus su nyin cig brag kha zhig na phar song ba la rmi lam yin snyam nas g.yang de la de'u song zhus pas/ rin po che'i zhal nas dang po'i snang ba de ban bun du song ba yin/ gnyis pa de 'od gsal gyis khyab pa yin/ gsum pa de sems nang du gnas pa yin/ de kun la bcos rgyu med gsung*/ yang thengs cig rig pa rang gsal ci yang ma rdugs pa zhig byung*/ gzhan ci yang mthong ba med pa re re tsam byung*/ de la goms par byas na 'byung ba'i rim gyis bsdus nas/ yul 'di dor nas rig pa'i ngo bo de chos kyi sku yin nam zhus pas ci yang lus sems gnyis su byas kyang gnyis su ma song*/ thams cad 'od gsal du song nas dngos po dang mtshan ma med pa zhig la sangs rgyas zer ba yin gsung*/ yang thengs cig dro skad re re tsam du dran pa med par song ba zhig byung zhus pas/ rin po che'i zhal nas/ 'o de mi 'dod shos cig po de yin/ sngon yang de 'dra ba zhig gis mgo skor mang du byung gsung*/ zhi gnas rab cig lha mi'i rgyu tsam yin/ da lta bsgoms bzang ba de sang gnangs yal nas 'gro ba yin/ rig pa 'di rnam rtog gi phyir breng breng ma btang bar/ rnam rtog ci byung sems su shes par gyis/ gnyis byung sems su shes par gyis/

rnam rtog ci tsam mang ba yin na/ rnam rtog mi 'dod pa re re byung ba'i dus su/ rig pa de la gtod la sems su shes par gyis/ yang ma nus na glod la zhog (6na)gsung*/ yang bsgoms pas mgo dang ro stod na ba zhig byung ste sems su shes pa rang gis phan nam zhus pas/ de la gnad cig yod/ na ba de rang gi sems su shes par byas la de nas nad de sos par bya snyam pa ci 'byung na/ de stong pa nyid nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por shor bya ba yin/ nad de rang la bltas pas kha dog dang dbyibs gang gis kyang ngo bor ma grub pa de yang sems kyi rang bzhin du shes pas/ nad zhi ba chos nyid yin gsung*/ yang thengs cig sngar dang mi 'dra ba zhig byung*/ gnas pa de yang chung du song*/ rig pa sing nge gtad pa'i dus su rnam rtog ci byung de'i ngang du song*/ rnam rtog re re byung nyams de bas bzang du song*/ der rig pa lhod de byas pa'i dus su nang du yang gsal stong gi nyams ci yin cha med pa zhig byung*/ rjes thob la 'bras bu sems su 'dug /sems las phyi rol gang yang grub pa med par 'dug zhus pas/ rin po che'i zhal nas/ 'o na de rang yin/ spyod 'jug las/ gnya' shing gang la blta zhes bshad de shes pa rgod par 'dug pas/ khru gang tsam du dngos po chung ba zhig la rig pa lhan ne btang nas rnam rtog gang mi 'dod pa ci byung yang de la rig pa gtod pa yin/ bying ba 'dra na yang gtod pa yin/ de nas shes pa rung du song nas thag ring du yang gtad pas chog /zhi gnas dang sems nyid kyi don la gnas pa gnyis mi gcig /zhi gnas ni ci yang dran pa de yin/ sems nyid kyi don la gnas pa rig pa gtad pa'i dus su/ rnam rtog ci byung gsal stong gi nyams su song ba de la/ bag yun ring yang mi lto/ de rig pa sgor ton bton pa bya ba yin/ lar rig pa kun khyab pa bya ba yin gsung*/ yang 'jam rlung mnan pa'i dus su gsha' ma mnan rgyu ni med/

drod ni che bar 'dug zhus pas/ rin po che'i zhal (6ba)nas/ rlung dag par 'byongs bya ba yin/ bzang de ka bzhin bsgoms pas chog /de bas kyang rig pa rang ma yengs/ tshan cig na da res nga la cis kyang mi gnod pas bsdad pa bas 'gro ba rang 'phel zer te/ de tsa na gnod bdo ba yin no// 'o na da rung 'o skol gnyis gtam pas sdug par 'dug ste yang goms pas yin gsung*/ 'o na rig pa gtad pa'i dus su dngos po gang la mthong ba med par gsal stong de la yun ring yang skyon cang 'ong ngam zhus pas/ rin po che'i zhal nas/ de la yun ring drags na yang ltengs pa dang*/ rmugs pa'i zhad cig yod pas/ shigs kyis bshigs/ lhod kyis glod nas/ phyi nang med par gsal stong gi nyams 'byung ba yin pas/ yang yang bsgom pa yin gsung*/ de'i dus su gsal stong gi nyams ci yin cha med pa zhig byung zhus pas/ de sangs rgyas kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes bya ba yin/ 'o skol gyis de ga nas shes gsung*/ yangs thengs cig gsal yang gtad pa med pa de gzhi med du 'gro bar 'dug zhus pas/ de don dam gnyug ma rang gi ngo bo bya ba yin/ de bzhin du nad kyi dngos po ci byung yang*/ de la rig pa gtad pas gzhi med du 'gro ba chos nyid yin/ de bzhin du gdon dang cho 'phrul la sogs pa gang ci byung yang*/ de rang la rig pa gtod pa yin gsung*/ yang dngos po la sogs pa rig pa gtod pa de la/ thag nye ring la khyad ci yod zhus pas/ shes pa rgod pa la thag nye ba dngos po chung ba la shes pa gtod pa yin/ bying na lag mthon po'i dngos po chung ba la shes pa gtod dgos pa yin/ yang thengs cig sgom pa'i dus su/ rjed thabs la dngos po ci yang med pas stong pa tsam tsam pa re byung zhus pas de kun thams cad nyams kyi khyad par yin/ ston pa rnams kyi (7na)dbu ma'am/ sems tsam pha rol phyin pa'am/ sngags sam grub mtha' mi 'dra ba re re 'dod par 'dug ste/

bsam phugs gcig yin/ chos thams cad sems su ma 'dus pa gcig kyang med/ bsams pas bde gsal du sing nge 'dug pa de gcig po bskyangs pas kyang lhar skye nges snyam pa zhig byung nas/ 'o skol rang gi lhan cig skyes sbyor 'di gdams ngag zab par 'dug /rnam rtog byung ba gang byung*/ gang mi 'dod pa ci byung yang sems su shes par byed/ ci dang ci byed pa thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma tsam la sems sbyong ba yin no gsung*/ yang thengs cig dngos po re re la rig pa dwangs te hrig ge gtad pa'i rjes la/ lhod kyis glod nas bzhag pas/ dngos po gang yang med par gsal stong ngang du cham cham 'dug /de'i dus su gang 'dod pa'i sar song yong*/ rtsig pa dang ri la yang rdugs rdugs mi 'dra ba na zhus pas/ 'o de khyod kyi de nyams bzang po dpe med cig yin/ lta ba ni dngos po rig pa gsal sing nge ba de yin/ de sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes chen po yin te/ de la brten nas bsgoms pas da rung 'gro ba'i skas kyi rim pa bzhin du 'ong ba yin/ da rung de 'dra ba brgya dang stong 'ong gsung*/ rin po che sgam po pa dang*/ rin po che mtshur phu ba gnyis kyi zhu ba zhus lan// //bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// byin rlabs can gyi rlan gyi dgon pa ru// bdag nyid dbu ma'i gnas su rlung tshud pas// mi rtog bde gsum dbyer med don mthong nas// de yi don rtogs bla ma rje la zhus// zhus lan brjed 'jigs cung zad yi ger bris// bdag gis bsgoms pas rnam rtog thams cad dang bral ba/ rang bzhin gyis 'od (7ba)gsal ba/ ngo bo bde ba de gsum dbyer med pa/ brjod du ma btub pa zhig byung ba'i dus su/ nam mkha' la byang chub sems dpa' mang po'i gzugs rol mo'i sgra sgrogs shing*/ bi ri ti ri gsung gin gda' na/ de ci lags zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas rlung dbu mar tshud pa yin/

cung rang rlung bcun drag pas/ rtsub rlung du song ba yin/ rtsub rlung dang 'jam rlung gi khyad ci lags zhus pas/ rtsub rlung ni steng 'og gi rlung gnyis ka zug dang bcas nas thub tshad du 'dzin pa yin te/ dper na yur ba chus brgyangs nas 'bo zhing 'dral ba dang 'dra bar/ log pa mang po 'ong bas/ mdze la sogs pa skyon can du 'gro nyen yod gsung*/ 'jam rlung gi steng rlung sum cha/ 'og rlung sum gnyis bzung nas lte ba'i bar du 'dzin/ zug rngu byung tsa na dal gyis gtong ba yin te log pa mi yong bas de legs pa yin gsung*/ de gnyis kyi dmigs pa gtad lugs zhus pas 'dra gsung*/ 'o na rlung dbu mar tshud pa la dus du yod zhus pas/ rang bzhin gyis tshud pa la bzhi'am brgyad yod de/ bzhi ni dang por sangs rgyas pa'i dus tshud/ ra ro ba dang brgyal ba dang*/ pho mo'i snyoms 'jug dus su tshud/ brgyad ni de'i 'khor yin/ rlung g.yas g.yon du 'pho ba dang*/ zhe sdang drag po skyes pa dang*/ gnyid mthug po dang*/ mig gis gzugs mthong nas 'dzin pa med pa'i dus dang brgyad la 'jug ste ji lta ba'i don ma rtogs pas ye shes byi po bya ba yin/ 'dir bla ma'i gdams ngag gis lhan cig skyes pa'i rkyen byas nas dus gsum du 'jug ste/ bum pa'i dbang gi dus dang*/ rmi lam 'od gsal zin pa dang*/ rlung la sogs pa bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis tshud pa'i dus su/ ji lta bu'i don ma bcos pa de rtogs pa yin gsung*/ (8na)'o na tsan+ḍā li la dmigs nas rlung bcun pa dang*/ mi rtog pa bsgoms nas rlung bcun pa stobs gang che zhus pas/ tsan+ḍā li che ste tsan+ḍā li la dmigs pa rnon pos ma yengs par bzung na/ dang po drod 'ur gyis skye/ de nas bde ba skye/ de nas mi rtog pa shugs 'byung du 'ong bas na/ tsan+ḍā li bogs che ba yin gsung*/ dang por drod skyes par shes nas/ bde ba dang mi rtog pa'i go ba ji tsam zhig la 'jog pa lags zhus pas/

tshad bzung du mi btub dpe dpyid kyi dus su chu dros pas/ 'khyag pa kun zhu nas myu gu skye/ de las lo ma dang*/ sdong bu dang*/ me tog dang 'bras bu smin pa ltar/ rlung dang tsan+ḍā li las drod skye/ de nas bde ba zug rngu dang bcas pa lte bar cag gis 'ong*/ de'i dus su bde ba de 'khor lo bzhi ru sems bzung nas/ sdod pa'i bde ba lus thams cad la khyab nas/ rtog pa thams cad shugs kyis 'gags nas/ zag pa med pa'i bde ba chen po zhes bya ste/ 'og ma 'og ma ni rnam rtog gong ma gong ma'i shugs las 'byung ba las/ 'di lta bu yin zhes bstan du mi btub/ bstan pas rlung dbu mar tshud pa de rang yin gsung*/ 'o na rlung bcun pa'i mi rtog pa dang*/ rlung ma bcun pa'i mi rtog pa 'dra'am zhus pas/ mi 'dra/ rlung ma bcun pa'i mi rtog pa de tshor ba btang snyoms/ mi rtog pa ltengs po bya ba yin/ rlung gis bying rgod la sogs pa'i skyon bsal nas/ mi rtog pa rang gi mtshan nyid mngon sum du skye ba yin gsung*/ 'o na tshogs drug bkag nas nang du mi 'jug pa dang*/ tshogs drug ma bkag par 'dzin med du lhug par 'jog pa gnyis/ gang lags zhus pas/ nang du 'jog pa de kun gzhi dran pa'i sa bon la bsdus nas/ mi rtog par 'jog pa (8ba)yin/ yang dag pa ma yin/ de nyan thos dang*/ mu stegs la sogs pa la yang yod/ tshogs drug 'dzin med lhug par 'jog pa yin gsung*/ 'o na chos thams cad kyi 'bras bu 'chi ba'i dus su dgos pa yin lags pas/ sgom chen pa 'chi ba'i tshe/ gnad gcod kyi sdug bsngal lam/ shes pa ma rnyogs pa'i gong du 'pho na/ 'pho ba gang rno/ hi ka nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang bsam du mi rung ba'i 'pho ba bya gsung*/ de gnyis ci ltar bgyi zhus pas/ gzhi saṃ bu ṭi nas bshad pa ltar/ sgal tshigs nang na yar pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa nyi shu rtsa bdun brtsigs pa'i lte bar/ pad+ma kun la rang gi shes pa as 'khris nas yod par bsams la/

dpa' bo'i go chas smad kyi srin po la sogs pa'i sgo bkag /dpa' mo'i go chas kha la sogs pa stod kyi sgo bkag la/ rlung hika drag tu drangs la/ hik+ka zhes brjod pas/ de lte ba'i a de skud pa la 'khris nas/ pad+ma re re'i nang du thon par bsam pa la 'pho ba sbyong dus/ bcun byas la/ yang ka hika ces/ steng rlung yang nang du drangs/ a yang thur la dbab bo// rgas nas 'pho ba ni ma nus/ nyer gcig gi hi kas gyen la drangs la/ ka hika gis mar mi dbab par yang dang yang du bya/ 'pho ba'i tshe nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyis drangs la/ shes pa rang gang 'dod kyi gnas su btang gsung*/ de phar 'pho'am zhus pas/ des cung mi 'ong snying 'gul bas snying 'dar du 'ong*/ de'i rjes la bsam du mi rung ba'i 'pho ba bya/ des the tshom med par 'ong gsung*/ 'o na mi rtog pa bsgom pa'i sgom chen yin na/ de ltar bgyi'am zhus pas/ nga'i bla ma chen po'i zhal nas/ 'chi ba'i dus su gnad gcod kyi sdug bsngal gyis 'tsher na/ gong du 'pho ba yin te/ de mi dga' bar 'dug gsung*/ (9na)'o na ji ltar bgyi zhus pas/ 'chi ba'i dus su seng ge'i nyal stabs su gzhogs g.yas pa 'og tu bcug la blos nyal te/ lus dang sems phral la sems dga' ldan la sogs par rang gang 'dod kyi gnas su btang ste/ der mi rtog par bzhag pa rang dga' ba yin gsung*/ des 'pho'am zhus pas dgun gyi me tog bsdus pa bya ba/ ston ka smin pa'i me tog la reg pas spungs kyis 'gro ba dang 'dra bar/ 'chi ka'i dus su/ 'byung ba bsdus pa'i gnad kas lus sems 'brel bas/ gnad gcod kyi sdug bsngal yang mi yong bar myur du 'pho ba yin gsung*/ 'o na btsan thabs kyi 'pho ba dang*/ sbyangs te 'pho ba'i go ba ci tsug lags zhus pas btsan thabs sdig po che'am/ mi tha mal pa'i lus sems dbyug pa la 'gyel ba la sogs pa yin/ sbyangs te 'pho ba sgom chen pas/ hik+ka bcu bdun pa'am/

'khrul 'khor drug pa'am/ bsre ba gong nas sbyong ba de yin mod gsung*/ 'o na 'pho bas bar do ji ltar 'byung zhus pas/ bar do la rnam pa gsum yod de/ da ltar rang skye shi bar do bya ba bar do rang yin/ rmi lam dang 'dra mod/ rmi lam bar do'i gdams ngag da lta bsgoms pas rmi lam du 'od gsal zin/ de lam yin/ srid pa bar dor 'bras bu'i 'od gsal dang bsre ba yin gsung*/ rmi lam zin nas rjes sad pa'i dus su/ ji ltar bsgom zhus pas rjes sad pa'i dus su/ mdang gi rmi lam dang da lta'i snang ba 'di khyad ci yod snyam du bsgoms te/ khyad med pa rang yin gsung*/ 'o na rngog jo sras pas/ gnyid la chos skur bsgom/ rmi lam la longs skur bsgom gsung ba de lags sam zhus pas/ gnyid ma rig pa yin pas chos skur bsgom du ga la btub/ (9ba)bsgoms nyams med par bshad pa'i chos bya ba yin/ rmi lam zin nas chos sku 'od gsal ngos bzung nas bsgom pa yin mod/ de'i dus su rmi lam dang sgyu lus dang 'bras bu 'od gsal bsre ba na bsre ba yin mod/ 'o na 'chi ba'i dus su 'byung ba'i sdud lugs sam/ snang ba dang*/ mched pa dang*/ thob pa dang*/ 'od gsal gyi rtags ji ltar 'ong zhus pas/ 'chi ba'i dus su sa chu la thim pas lus mi theg /chu me la thim pas kha sna skam/ de'i dus su snang ba'i rtags phyi rtags zla ba shar ba lta bu/ nang rtags srin bu me khyer lta bu 'byung*/ rnam rtog brgyad cu las zhe sdang las gyur pa sum cu rtsa gsum 'gags/ me rlung la thim pa'i dus su/ lus kyi drod sdud/ snang ba mched pa la thim pa'i rtags/ phyi rtags nyi ma shar ba lta bu/ nang rtags mar me lta bu/ 'dod chags las gyur pa bzhi cu tham pa 'gag /sgom chen pa la mkha' spyod nas bsu ba 'ong*/ sdig can la gshin rje'i pho nya 'ong*/ rlung gi 'khor ba zhig tsa na/ phyi dbugs ring nang dbugs thung la gcod/ snang ba thob pa'i phyi rtags mun pa lta bu/

nang rtags mar me lta bu/ gti mug las gyur pa bdun 'gag /der nang du dbugs tsam la gnas pa'i dus su/ spyi bo'i pha las thob pa'i haṃ rdib/ lte ba'i ma las thob pa'i gtum mo'i rang bzhin dang a shad/ thabs shes rab kyi yi ge gnyis snying gar phrad pas ro mdangs sa le zhag gcig gam gnyis sam gsum mam bzhi'am lnga drug tu 'ong*/ de'i rjes la 'bras bu'i 'od gsal phyi rtags skya rengs shar ba lta bu'am/ nang rtags nam mkha' la sprin dengs pa lta bu 'byung*/ der lam gyi 'od gsal dang*/ 'bras bu'i 'od gsal 'dres pas/ (10na)'od gsal de yang rang bzhin gyis gsal ba/ rnam par rtog pa thams cad dang bral ba/ zag pa med pa'i bde bas gang ba ste/ snang ba yang bde ba'i rang bzhin du 'char ba yin/ dmyal ba la snang bas gnod pa ma bskyal te/ snang ba sdug bsngal du mthong bas bcings/ sangs rgyas la snang bas phan ma btags te snang ba bde bar shar bas grol gsung*// 'o na da lta'i lam gyi 'od gsal dang*/ rlung dbu mar tshud pa'am/ dbang gsum pa'i dus sam/ rmi lam 'od gsal lam de rnams dang*/ 'bras bu'i 'od gsal ngo bo 'dra'am/ 'bras bu'i 'od gsal de yun ji tsam mchis zhus pas/ ngo bo 'dra/ da lta yang lam dang 'bras bu rlung dbu mar tshud pa'i dus su 'dra ste yun thung*/ dpe tshes gcig gi zla ba lta bu 'ong*/ 'bras bu'i 'od gsal dang 'dres tsa na yun ring ste/ tha ma zhag phyed dang bzhi 'ong*/ dpe nya'i zla ba lta bu yin gsung*/ de'i dus su gdams pa can la bde ba longs sku/ gsal ba sprul sku/ mi rtog pa chos sku/ de gsum dbyer med pa ngo bo nyid kyi sku dang bzhi tshang bas/ yon tan thams cad rdzogs pa'i bar do bya ba yin te/ mtshan brjod las/ skad cig gcig gis rdzogs sangs rgyas// skad cig gcig gis bye brag phyed// ces pa dang*/ do ha las/ mkhyen pa'i skad cig gcig nyid la// shes bya'i dkyil 'khor kun khyab ltar// rnam rtog mi mnga' ci yang sa le mkhyen// zhes pa de yin gsung*/

'o na de la gzugs sku gnyis kyi 'gro don ji ltar 'byung zhus pas/ bya ba dang byed pa'i bsam pa mi mnga' yang*/ las dag pa'i sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la rnam snang mtshan dpes brgyan par snang*/ 'dzam bu'i gling bye ba phrag brgya la sogs (10ba)par thub pa drug tu snang bas don byed par yin gsung*/ de rnams slob dpon gang gi bzhed pa lags zhus pas/ nā ro pa'i brgyud pa/ bla ma ti phu pa/ bla ma a dul badz+ra dang*/ nga'i 'dod pa la yang da lta'i lam gyi 'od gsal dang*/ bar dor lam dang 'bras bu bsre bar 'dod pa yin/ bla ma bal pos da lta rang 'bras bu yin gsung ba la/ de'i phyir nyin gyi rings la nga dang gnyis rtsod pa yang yang byas pa'i lo rgyus gsung*/ 'o na 'bras bu'i 'od gsal de la ma zin na ji ltar mchi zhus pas/ bla ma'i lhan cig byed pa'i gdams ngag gis/ da ltar rlung dbu mar tshud pa'i dus su/ lam gyi 'od gsal ngo shes pas/ 'bras bu'i 'od gsal mi zin mi srid/ gdams ngag med pa rnams 'od gsal la bred nas/ lus kyi tshang 'tshol bas 'khor bar 'khyams pa yin/ gal te 'od gsal ma zin na/ 'bras bu'i 'od gsal las dag pa'i sgyu lus bya ba yi dam gyi lha mtshan dpes brgyan par ldang*/ mtshur ston dbang nge na re/ sdug pa snying re rje/ gzhan kun sems la rten mi 'dod/ nga'i lha rje mar pa sems la rten 'dod/ bar do ru sems nyid 'di ngo bo lha/ nyams myong bde ba/ don skye med bya ba 'bras bu'i mthar thug yin/ slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa'i bdun ldan gyis zer/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu sangs rgyas gzugs su 'dod/ de la bdag dang rtsod pa yang byas te de min/ de dag pa'i sgyu lus bya ba yin te/ des phyogs bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' brgya stong la dbang bskur ba dang*/ chos zhus nas mthar thug sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' thob pa yin gsung*/ 'o na 'pho ba'i 'bras bu du bdog zhus pas/

sdig po che mtshams med pa lnga byed pa la btsan thabs su 'phos nas gzugs med du skye ba dang gcig /(11na)lha dang mi'i 'khor los sgyur ba'i mngal bdams nas 'pho ba dang gnyis/ sbyangs te 'phos pas 'bras bu 'od gsal ngos bzung nas sangs rgyas pa dang gsum/ 'od gsal zin pa dag pa'i sgyu lus su langs nas 'bras bu sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' thob pa dang bzhi yin gsung ngo*// 'o na 'od gsal las rigs drug tu ji ltar 'khyams lags zhus pas/ gdams ngag med pa rnams 'od gsal la bred nas lus 'tshol te/ srid pa bar dor yid kyi lus len/ de la ma dag pa'i sgyu lus shes bya ste/ de'i mtshan nyid ni/ sngon byung srid pa'i sha gzugs can// zhes gsungs pas/ 'bras bu'i 'od gsal las sngar gyi yid kyi lus su ldang*/ gzhan gyis gang len gyis ldang bar 'dod pa yang yod/ dbang po kun tshang thogs med ldan// zhes gsungs pas/ sngar bas tshor ba rags pa/ thogs pa med pa ni chos kyi dbyings dang*/ ma'i mngal min pa gzhan la mi thogs/ gzhan la rdugs zer te mi rdugs/ rigs mthun lha mig dag pas mthong*// zhes gsungs pas/ bar do nang dang lhas mthong*/ las kyi rdzu 'phrul shugs dang ldan// zhes gsungs pas/ ye shes kyi rdzu 'phrul min/ srid pa bar dor tshe ji tsam thub na/ zhag bdun nam bcu bzhi'am/ nyi shu rtsa gcig gam/ rtsa brgyad dam/ so lnga'am/ zhag gnyis sam/ mthar thug na zhe dgu thub/ de nas tshe 'pho bas rkyen pha ma la 'dod chags shing mngal du 'jug pas zhe sdang ngo*// 'o na bar dor gsang sngags gseb lam gyi gdams ngag bgyi ba bdog skad pa de gang lags zhus pas/ srid pa bar do la rang sems ma yengs par bya ba dang gcig /pha ma'i mngal du mi 'gro bar bya'o snyam pas mngal du mi 'gro ba dang gnyis/ 'bras bu'i 'od gsal ngo shes par byas (11ba)pas/ bde ba la gnas pa dang gsum yin gsung*/ zhus lan*// //bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// slob dpon rin po che la/

dang por chos ji ltar gsan pa dang*/ bar du ji ltar grub pa dang*/ tha mar thugs rgyud la ji ltar 'khrungs pa dang*/ dang po nas da ltar yan chad du sku nyams la khyad ci gda'/ rtogs pa la khyad ci gda'/ phyi'i snang ba 'di ji ltar gzigs/ thams cad sba gsang mi mnga' ba zhig gsung par zhu zhus pas/ rje mnyam pa med pa'i zhal nas spyir ni gsang bar bshad pa yin/ gnas pa'i nyams smras pas gnod kyin 'dug /ngo bo skyes nas bzlar rung ni mi rung bar 'dug ste/ gnod ni mi gnod par 'dug /ngas ni phan du re nas de snga yang ma gsang*/ tshogs su yang bzlas/ da yang khyed la bshad na dang por sman bslabs/ de nas mnga' ris ba la sngags mang du nyan/ de nas nga'i grogs po 'gongs ston bya ba na re/ slob dpon byang chub sems dpa' la bla ma mi la'i gdams ngag yod par 'dug /mi la grub thob yin gsung*/ 'o cag slob dpon la zhu zer ba la/ cang gnang ngam byas pa la/ zhu dang gzhan zhor la 'ong gis zer nas zhus pas/ nga la zhag bdun gnas pa bzang po byung nas dris pas/ sgom yin gsungs nas/ slob dpon dang gnyis kas bsgom du byas/ 'gong ston na re khyed la cig byung byung 'dra na nga la bzlos dang zer/ nga la sgom zhig byung byas pa la/ kho na re nga la yang na sgom zhig byung ba'am/ yang na mal 'di nyid du shi ba zhig las med zer nas bsgoms pas khong la yang gnas pa byung nas mal nas yi ge bris nas/ 'gong ston gyi 'khor ba der zad do zer nas 'dug /de nas mnga' ris pa la mkhan po zhus nas lo nyi shu rtsa drug la chig rdzogs rab tu byung*/ lo nyi shu rtsa (12na)brgyad la 'gong ston dang gnyis dbu rur phyin/ dge bshes snyug rum pa la bka' gdams kyi gdams ngag zhus/ sems bskyed kyang zhus/ dus da lta phan chad kun rdzob kyi byang chub sems dang 'bral ma myong*/ der mi mang po'i gseb tu bsdad pas sngar gyi sgom ngan du song bas/ blo ma bde nas rgya yon bdag can du bsgom zer nas der phyin/

de na mi nyung bas gnas pa la skyed byung*/ der lam rim gyi khrid nas mi rtag pa dang las 'bras 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsgoms pas sngar gyi nyams 'gyur/ sngar bde stong gi nyams yod pa la phyis blo sna thung du song*/ skyo ba yid 'byung ba shas che bar byung*/ 'gong ston na re ci ltar byung zer/ nga la de ltar byung byas pa las/ nga la yang 'di ltar byung bka' gdams 'di kun cig gcig yod yod 'dra zer/ der lo gsum bsdad tsa na bla ma mi la de grub thob yin par 'dug /da lta zhal bzhugs pa la yud cig ma skor na phyis 'gyod yong bsam nas/ 'gong ston dang gnyis yar 'gro ba'i zhu ba byas pa la/ 'dir bsdad na thabs lam gyi steng du skyel ba yin te/ khyed 'gro na yas ma rang can du shog cig gsungs nas/ de nas phyin pas mgur mor sleb dus/ 'gong ston na/ kho'i rogs byas/ e na mgo theg pa rang bzhag nas phyin/ bla ma dang de ring mjal te 'ong ba'i da nang*/ bla ma'i zhal nas di ring nga'i 'dir dbus pa ston pa gcig 'ong ba 'gro ba la phan thogs pa zhig 'ong bar 'dug gsung*/ nag po char du byas pa'i kha yar 'dug pa zhig tu phyin nas/ nga thag ring bas lus sems dub nas 'dug tsa na/ khong na re a re skyid zer/ skyid pa ji ltar yin byas pas/ da nang bla ma 'di skad gsung byas pa la/ sngar gyi dub pa kun sing gis song*/ de na 'dug (12ba)tsa na bla ma'i nye gnas se ban ston chung bya ba gcig byon/ yas kyi chos zhu rogs ngas byed pa yin/ bla ma'i spyan sngar lo sum cu rtsa gcig la gshegs zer nas phyin/ phyag mang po yang dag par 'tshal nas/ zla ba bzhi'i lam nas yong bas thugs la btags par zhu byas pa la/ khyod kyi zla ba bzhi bas nga'i gan du rgya gar nas kyang 'ong gsung*/ nged gnyis 'ongs nas zla ba gcig na nas lus byas pa la/ nga dang las 'brel med pa zhig 'dug gsung*/ bka' gdams pa'i dge bshes kun thugs la 'dogs par 'dug pa la ma chags par mda' btang ba bzhin bla ma'i spyan sngar phyin/

las 'brel tshan chen po yod par 'dug /der gdams ngag zhus tsa na/ bla ma byang chub sems dpa'i gdams ngag yag par ma thob par 'dug /bla ma la sngar gyi bsgoms stangs phul bas yags par 'dug ste de tshod tsam yin gsung*/ lan cig chos 'dri ma yag pa zhig la lteng lteng po de 'dra ma bsgoms par/ srog rtsol sgoms gsung*/ lan cig tsa na se ban ston chung dang*/ bla ma chos gtam shor bas/ ngas se ban ston chung gi zhor bkyags pas/ khyod rang yang sgom 'bul ba'i lugs 'di skad zer ba yin/ nga khyod ltar bsgom tsa na cig gnang ba gsung*/ bla ma de la bsgom du mi byed par 'dug snyam/ ngas chos dri ma mkhas pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas glen pa khyod las kyang 'dri mang ba ma byung gsung*/ dgun smad tsa na khyod sgom rem po 'dug pas/ ras thub tu rung ba yin te gsung*/ ras shig gon nas bsgoms pa la yag rab tu 'dug pa la/ gnyid thun cig log nas sad tsa na lus po rdo ba bzhin du song nas mi yong bar 'dug /dbyar de bsgoms pas ston drod de dus gcig tu byung nas/ (13na)lung pa sum shor grong mo zhig gi mdor bskyas/ der ras hrul po zhig gon nas 'dug tsa na/ bla ma byon nas des dros sam gsung*/ da lta dro bar gda' ste/ dgun kyang dros sam zhus pas/ de nas dror 'gro ba yin/ da lta nga bas khyod bzang bar 'dug gsung*/ lo sum cu rtsa gnyis la mar yong*/ lar zla ba bcu gsum las ma bsdad/ mar 'ongs tsa na bar chad la gzobs shig gsung ba la/ skabs su yi dwags kyis gtses nas bzlas pa mang bar byas/ bla ma mkhyen gda'/ de nas rgya yon bdag can du phyin pas khyod de tsam du gda'/ de tshod na nga rang bla ma'i spyan sngar sdod pa yin pa la snyam pa/ srog mtha' yin pa nas ma rnyed nas sbyangs/ nad pa gcig gsos pa la nas khal phyed dang gnyis byin pa/ nged gnyis la yod pas tshags ma byung*/ de nas 'ol kar 'ongs pas kyang nas ma rnyed/ dwags por phyin pas zhed pa'i 'phro la gsar byung*/

drod kyang res bzang res ngan pa las ma byung*/ sngar sgom bzang po yod pa yang bka' gdams pa'i grwa sar mi mang po'i gseb tu bsdad pas shor/ dben par bsdad dgos bya ba yang de ltar yin/ dka' thub byas pas lus skam/ ting nge 'dzin shor/ bla ma'i zhal nas bye ma la mar mi 'ong*/ yungs kar la mar yod pa yin/ lus bcud med pa la ting nge 'dzin mi 'ong gsung*/ bla ma'i zhal nas nga'i gtum mo 'di ma bzhag cig /gsung ba dran nas bsgoms pa dang*/ se ba lung du bza' yang che bar byung nas/ yang ting nge 'dzin byung sgom pa la yang bza' cher dgos par gda'/ bla ma'i spyan snga nas log nas lo gsum na drod klungs su tshud/ dbyar de tsam ma bsgoms kyang 'ong yin 'dug /na mo shod na 'dug tsa na/ ting (13ba)nge 'dzin la ji tsam btang

rlung sems nang du bzung ba tsam gyis 'ong ba yin/ btang 'ong ba byung*/ gnyid thun gcig min pa rgyun ma chad par byung bas/ ci tsam 'ong bltas pas zhag bcu gsum du rgyun ma chad par byung*/ de nas bag ngan du song*/ rtsa gud pa 'dra/ nyon mongs pa thams cad mgo non nas ngos mi zin pa yang byung*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bde bas blo phrogs nas 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yid la mi 'gyu ba yang byung*/ sprang ston na re khyod la ci tsug byung zer/ nga la ni 'dod pa 'di kho na thu bar byung zer ba la/ nga la 'dod pa'i yon tan ngos ma zin pa byung*/ yas la ji ltar byung byas pas/ nga la bud med la bde ba yod snyam de la brten nas chags pa skye yin 'dug zer/ kho de tsug snyam pa'i 'phro la yang yid la 'gyu ba ngo ma shes pa byung*/ dge bshes sgre pa'i zhal nas/ khyed ting nge 'dzin bzang zer ba ji ltar yod zer ba la/ ne'u thang bde mo la gom pa 'dor ba dang*/ nga'i rgyud kyi ting nge 'dzin skrun pa la khyad med/ thang la bsdad skyil mo krung byas/ mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya byas rlung nems byas pas/ rlung nang du pur gyis song nas bde ba mi rtog pa 'ong ba la dka' sla med/ bla ma'i spyan snga nas 'ongs nas lo bdun na se ba lung du sems kyi ngo bo en tsam mthong*/ de nga la ni skyed dka' bar byung*/ da ltar khyed la ni tshegs med du skye yin 'dug /nga la ni rmi lam bzang ba zhig rmis pa dang gdod dge sbyor skyes/ gser brkos pas gzhong pa gang rnyed/ nga yang brgyad stong pa gcig 'bri dgos snyam pa zhig rmis/ de nas cher ma lon par nges shes shig skyes/ dang po ni sems sa chod pa zhig byung*/ lhan cig skyes sbyor min pa na/ bsgom pa gtum mo kho na bsgoms/ thams cad rtog par 'dug /rtog pa glo bur bar 'dug /de thams cad sems su 'dug (14na)snyam pa zhig nang nas shugs 'byung du byung*/ de nas shes pa'i ngo bo de la sngar 'dris kyi mi dang phrad pa 'dra ba zhig byung*/

rang gi ngo bo de yer gyis mthong*/ snga ma'i sgom de dang mi 'dra bar sing nge yer re ba kha na ye re ba zhig byung*/ de nas sngar gyi chos kun dang bla ma'i mgur kun dang*/ yo blo la bcug pa bzhin bkra lam gyis byung*/ res ka ni snang ba yang sgyu ma lta bur wal wal byung*/ res ni cog ge ba lta bu yang byung*/ res ni shes pa rang gi ngo bo gcig pur song*/ de rang bsgom du song nas bsgom rgyu mi 'dug /bsgom mkhan mi 'dug sngar gyi chos thams cad phyi shun du song nas/ rig pa'i ngo bo rten med du song nas snang ba la blo gtad ma dgos pa zhig byung*/ res ni stong pa res ni sgyu ma ltar 'char yin 'dug /snang ba la rtogs dpyod bya ma dgos/ res ni nyams la rgyangs rgyangs song ba snyam byed pa ste/ de nyams rang du 'dug /rtogs pa brtan du song ba las/ bogs 'don rgyu cher mi gda'/ bar skabs su rong phu'i gnas brtan mkhar phur ni/ rtogs pa la bogs shig byung*/ ji ltar na sngar kun gyi rtog pa ban bun byung tsa na/ med na dga' snyam byed pa byung ba la/ de nas rtog pa 'od gsal 'ba' zhig tu song nas/ der rtog pas mi gnod pa zhig byung*/ da yang gang gis kyang mi gnod snyam pa zhig byung*/ de nas 'od gsal 'ba' zhig tu song nas/ dus da lta yan chad du rgyun chad med/ de nas nyin mtshan med par rgyun ma chad/ rnal 'byor pa la shi ma shi med/ bar do med snyam pa zhig byung*/ phyis ni skyid du tshor ba zhig byung*/ sngon tsa na bzlas pa mang po byas kyang 'dres tshur gnod/ da lta bzlas pa rdog gcig ma byas kyang 'dres gnod pa gcig kyang mi nus par 'dug /sngon chos mkhas dge bshes kun dang phrad (14ba)tsa na/ nyam nga ba sems byed/ da lta ni sangs rgyas byon kyang nyam mi nga*/ da lta ji ltar mkhas pa zhig dang bla'o zer yang shes rab kyi go phye nas nyam nga med/ rmi lam na bse'i ga'u gcig rnyed pa la/

sgom pa bkras g.yung na re/ nga la ston zer ba la/ mi ston/ 'di na jo bo rje'i gdung ring bsrel dang bka' gdams kyi man ngag yod pa yin byas pa la/ kho nan che bas kha phye ba zhig rmis te/ da lta mi la bag re phan pa 'di bka' gdams la brten nas phan thogs pa yin/ nā ro'i gdams ngag bshad pa mang ste/ bka' gdams dang ma 'brel bar phan pa bag nyung*/ nub gcig gi rmi lam na mi gnyis la zangs dung gtad nas/ 'bud du bcug pa la sbom phra gdung ma tsam du 'dug nas/ da lta yang dbus gtsang gi rgyal khams na zangs dung 'di tsam yod de mi yong*/ byas pa zhig rmis te de kho na bzhin du byung*/ 'ol ka srub na bzhugs tsa na mi nag po gcig bsad pa zhig rmis/ nga yang bdud la sogs pa'i bar chad kyis mi tshugs snyam pa la de kho na byung*/ nub gcig rmi lam na bu gcig yod pa'i mgo bcad pa zhig rmis/ 'jig rten na bu las gces pa med pa ste/ de la yang ma chags bya ba yin nam snyam pa la/ de kho na bzhin byung*/ de tshun chad rgyab pa dang bsad pa rmi ma myong*/ bka' gdams pa kun gyi zhal nas/ stong pa nyid rtogs na las 'bras la 'dzem du 'gro gsung ba la/ de med par 'dug /da lta nyams su babs/ bka' gdams pa la chos kyi babs shig 'dug gsung ngo*// //na mo gu ru/ bya lo'i dbyar zla 'bring po yi// bcu bzhi nub mo bag tsam snyung*// da ni nga sman mi za gsung*// rkyen gyi bag tsam la brten nas// yang yang du ni bzhad par mdzad// bco lnga'i nyi ma rtse la 'das// mchod khang chen mor pur (15na)mchod byas// bco brgyad nang par pur sbyangs tshe// gung thang rtse mor 'od phung mthong*// gnyal ba cig gis 'ja' mdung mthong*// 'ja' tshon mi 'dra lan mang byon// thugs ni ma tshig ngo mtshar skyes// rje 'od gsal gyi thugs la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ ngas dang lug lo la 'khrungs/ po lo bcu drug lon nas/ dge bshes

khyi lo la/ zangs dkar ba'i drung du phyin nas/ yo ga dang bde mchog la sogs pa'i rgyud sde rnams shes par bslabs/ lo nyi shu rtsa spre'u lo la/ drug la dbrong kar rab tu byung nas chig rdzogs byas/ bla ma mar yul ba dang byang chub sems dpa' gnyis la gsang sngags kyi dbang mang du zhus nas bsgoms pas/ zhi gnas kyi nyams bzang po byung*/ snang ba ban bun 'ja' tshon lta bur shar/ mi rtog pa nyin mtshan ngo mi shes pa byung*/ ji tsam 'ong bltas pas nyin zhag bcu gsum du bar ma chad par byung*/ de nas sgom ni nga rang bzang*/ dbu ru byang gi bka' gdams pa'i dge bshes rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa'i spyod 'gros blta snyam nas/ dge bshes snyug rum pa dang rgya yon bdag gnyis kyi spyan sngar pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam rim nyan/ mthar phyin mkhyen/ sku nyams su bzhes pas/ byang chub kyi sems thugs rgyud la mnga' ba de gnyis kyi bka' drin yin gsung*/ de nas bla ma mi la'i mtshan thos nas sems shin tu dad par gyur nas/ dge bshes pa la zhu ba byas/ gtsang du nyi ma bzhi bcu'i lam la phyin/ lo sum cu rtsa glang lo/ gcig la bla ma mi la dang mjal/ sngar gyi sgom nyams phul bas/ khyod kyi de sgom yin/ 'tshang rgya ba'i lam min gsung*/ yang dus gcig gi tshe na/ lteng lteng po de 'dra ba ma bsgom par srog rtsol sgoms gsung*/ lo (15ba)gcig tu srog rtsol bsgoms pas rlung gi yon tan thams cad rdzogs par byung*/ bde drod dang ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skrun pa la tshegs med snyam pa byung gsung*/ zla ba bcu gsum bla ma'i spyan sngar bsdad nas mar 'byon stag lo la/ kar gtor ma chen po zhig dbu thog tu bzhag nas/ mkha' 'gro dang chos skyong gi dbang bskur/ khyod kyis sems can gyi don mang po 'ong bar 'dug gi gsung*/ ci tsug gda' zhus pas/ khyod 'ong kar sems can gyi don yong ba'i mtshan ma zhig byung*/ 'di na bzhugs tsa na nga dang khyed gnyis bang 'gran pas/

khyod sngon la song*/ sems can gyi don nga bas khyod che bar 'ong bar 'dug byas pa zhig rmis/ yang dus gcig na pha bong sbra bas che ba gcig yul gzhan na phar bskyur ba dang*/ phyag gnyis kyis pha 'ong brdabs pas rdul phra rab tu spungs kyis 'gro yin 'dug /sku lus kyang bzang na nus pa la tshegs mi 'dug /phyi rol yul gyi 'jigs pa dang bral ba zhig 'dug byas pa zhig rmis gsung*/ de nas mar byon nas dge bshes sgre pa dang*/ lcags ri ba dang*/ bya yul ba la sogs pa la/ dpal mar me mdzad kyi gdams ngag rnams shin tu zhib par gsan gsung*/ de nas grwa pa rnams kyis thugs la 'khrungs lugs shig gsung bar zhu zhus pas/ gnas pa'i nyams ni bde ba dang gsal ba dang mi rtog pa gsum bsgoms tsa na 'ong la ma bsgoms tsa na mi 'ong*/ rtse gcig gi nyams ni spyod lam rnam bzhi la khyad yod/ gsal sing ba nam dran dran gyis 'ong*/ 'di rang yin snyam pa'i dang ba 'dren nus/ res 'ga' ni shes pa rlan dang bral nas sgom ye med dam snyam pa'ong*/ res 'ga' ni ma bsgoms kyang 'ong*/ res 'ga' ni bsgoms kyang mi 'ong*/ rtogs pa ma thob ste/ nges shes bag tsam skyes/ (16na)rtsa ba sems yin pas tshes gcig gi zla ba dang 'dra'o// ye shes kyi mgo tshugs pas lam sna zin pa yin no// de nas ye shes gsha' ma 'char te/ nga la rmi lam bzang po zhig rmis nas/ de nas cher ma lon par rig pa rang gi ngo bo yer gyis mthong*/ sngar 'dris pa'i mi dang phrad pa 'dra ba zhig byung*/ shes pa rang sgom du song nas bsgom rgyu mi 'dug /sgom mkhan mi 'dug /sems rten med gsal stong zhig tu shar/ 'di dang po nas ngo shes su thang pa zhig 'dug pa la snyam/ chos thams cad phyi shun du song*/ 'on kyang rnam rtog 'byung na mi dga'/ rtog pa 'di med na rung ba la snyam/ rnam rtog med na gsal stong rgyun chad med/ 'o de byung snyam/ de tsho gnyal gyi se ba lung du shor/

dbrong phur bskyas nas rtogs pa la skyed cig byung*/ sngar ni rnam rtog byung tsa na mi dga'/ rtog pa ma byung tsa na dga' ba de/ dbrong phur rnam rtog 'od gsal du shar nas/ rtog pa byung ba'i tshe 'od gsal 'od chad pa bzhin du song*/ gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa la shi ma shi med snyam pa zhig byung*/ bar do'i snang ba yang mi 'char/ bla ma rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ 'od gsal bar yang rgyun par gnas/ bar do'i grong khyer des mi mthong gsung pa de nga la shar bsam/ rnam rtog gis ma gnod pas 'od gsal la gang gis kyang mi chod par 'dug /'od gsal gyi rgyun 'khrigs nas/ gsal stong de la chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du byung*/ phyis byar lkog tu bskyal nas/ 'od gsal gyi 'dzin pa dang bral blo'i byed pas cung zad kyang ma gos/ sems nyid chos skur song*/ phyis zangs lung du bskyal nas 'da' ba'i bdun cu rtsa lnga/ lo la sku gsum gyi 'char lugs ngo shes gsungs so/ /rdo rje 'chang gis/ ji ltar chu la chu bzhag dang*// ji ltar mar la mar bzhag bzhin// rang gis rang gi ye shes ni// (16ba)legs mthong gang yin 'dir phyag yin// tai lo pas/ kyai ho 'di ni rang rig ye shes te// ngag gi blo 'das yid kyi spyod yul min// de bzhin kho na nyid kyi ye shes ni// tai lo nga yis ci yang bstan du med// nā ro pas/ snang ba'i mtshan nyid skye ba med// 'khor ba'i mtshan nyid gzhi rtsa bral// sems kyi mtshan nyid zung du 'jug /bla ma'i mtshan nyid brgyad par ldan// mar pas/ lta ba rlung sems gnyis su med// mi las/ phyogs ni gang du'ang ma lhung bya ba la rtsol dang*// srog rtsol gnad du chud pas dgos dgu rang la 'char// kha dog dbyibs dang bral bas dbang po'i yul las 'das// tshig dang tha snyad med pas brjod pa'i sgra las 'das// shes pa dang*/ yang*/ bskur thob med pa'i don rtogs na// dbang gi mchog ni de la bya// 'du 'bral med pa'i don rtogs na// grogs kyi mchog ni de la bya// skye shi med pa'i don rtogs na// tshe yi mchog ni de la bya// gnyis su med pa'i don rtogs na// lta ba'i mchog ni de la bya// gsung ngo*/

/rje sgam po pas/ rang sems la blta na lta ba yin// chos rnams sems su rtogs na rtogs pa yin// de la goms par byed pa sgom pa yin// ngo bo nyams su myong na nyams myong yin// de'i ngang la rgyun mi chad pa spyod pa yin// mngon du gyur na 'bras bu yin// gzhan la ston na 'phrin las yin// gsung ngo*/ /bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ spyir chos la byed lugs gnyis yin te/ mtshan nyid shes par byed pa dang*/ rtogs pa thob par byed pa gnyis yin/ thos bsam byed pa yang thabs yin/ nyon mongs pa'i grogs su ma song ba zhig dgos/ shes pa'i 'bras bu 'chad pa yin te/ gting nas phan par mi 'dug gsung*/ thos (17na)bsam gyi shes rab kyi lam ma sbyangs kyang bla ma dam pa gcig dang phrad nas/ de'i gdams ngag sgrub pa yin/ rgyud la rtogs pa bskyed par nus pa yin/ sgrub pa byed pa'i dus su/ 'jig rten pa'i rtog pa spong ba dag a cang ches te/ bstan bcos kyi tha snyad thams cad kyang brjed dgos pa yin/ thos pa rgya che ba yang tshig la rno ste/ don la brtul ba yin/ yon tan skyon du 'gyur ba yin/ sgrub pa rnal mar byed na/ chos lnga la gnas dgos pa yin te/ bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs pa dang*/ 'jig rten 'di la gdos thag bcad pa dang*/ 'gro ba rigs drug gar skyes kyang sdug bsngal du shes pa dang*/ sems can thams cad pha mar shes pas byams pa snying rje byang chub kyi sems dang ma bral ba zhig dgos pa yin gsung*/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gi lam rgyud la skye dgos/ de la yang mdung byi khung du 'jug pa dang*/ nam mkha' la skor ba'i dus gnyis yin/ sgrub pa'i lung zhus pa'i bla ma de dang mnyes shing thugs yid 'dres pa zhig dgos pa yin/ bka' brgyud 'di ni zab pas bka' rgya yod pa yin/ bsgrub mi nus pa la mi sbyin gsung ba yin/ dam tshig nyams na mkha' 'gro'i chad pa 'ong ba yin/ de bas bla ma mnyes par byas nas dam tshig ma nyams na/

gdams ngag tshig tu ma gsungs kyang*/ byin rlabs kyis rtogs pa nang nas 'char ba yin/ bla ma dang ni rdo rje 'dzin// gang gis tha dad med par mthong*// de la dngos grub 'byung ba yin// gsung ngo*// //bka' gdams kyi lam rim skyes bu gsum la blo sbyong ba 'di rtsis su che/ 'di med na gnyug ma rab rib skyes kyang nye du 'brel ba yul nor rdzas la chags nas mar la 'gro ba las yar la mi 'gro /de bas na tshe 'di blos btang*/ (17ba)snang grags kyi chos thams cad la rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur nges pa byas/ byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems sbyangs na/ gnyug ma med kyang*/ kho yar 'gro ba las mar mi 'gro gsung*/ gnyug ma rnal ma zhig rgyud la skyes na de gcig pus chog /de la lnga ste/ gnyug ma'i ngo bo ni med pa ma yin pa'i don skye 'gag dang bral ba de yin/ mtshan nyid ni rgyu rkyen gyis ma bskyed/ sangs rgyas kyis ma mdzad sems can gyis ma bcos pa de'o// 'bras bu ni skye 'gag dang bral ba de nyid chos sku yin/ de'i byin rlabs dang bsod nams bsags pa las/ gzugs sku gnyis kyi snang ba 'byung*/ nyams myong ni bde ba dang gsal ba mi rtog pa dpes mtshon du med pa 'byung*/ rgyu ni nyams myong de gtum mo las 'byung bas/ gnyug ma 'byung ba'i rgyu gtum mo yin/ gnyug ma skyes kyang gtum mo med par shes rab rkyang pa yin/ bogs chung*/ gtum mo yod na thabs shes rab ya ma bral ba yin gsung*/ rnal 'byor bzhi la/ rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor ni gsal la ma 'gags pa skad cig ma'i shes pa de yin/ spros bral gyi rnal 'byor ni rig pa'i ngo bo skye med du mthong bas/ yar sangs rgyas la mi re/ mar 'khor ba la mi dogs/ bar du snang ba la mi 'dzin gzhan gyis sgyur du mi btub pa'o// ro gcig gi rnal 'byor ni snang stong dbyer med du rtogs pa'o// bsgom du med pa'i rnal 'byor ni/

ci snang ci skyes ngo bo gcig tu shar bas dran pa'i dus na thams cad bsgom du 'ong ba'o// bar do ni/ dbang po rab la bar do med/ 'bring bar do lam du byed/ tha ma skye ba len pa yin/ rab ni rtogs pa rnal mar shar ba ste/ lus sems can yin yang sems sangs rgyas yin/ de'i yon tan mi snang zhe na/ med kyang yin te tshes gcig gi zla ba lta bu'o// yon tan (18na)thams cad nam mngon du byed ce na/ lus rgya dang bral ba'i dus su'o// 'bring bar do lam du ji ltar byed ce na/ da lta'i shes pa dang*/ rmi lam gyi shes pa dang*/ 'chi kha'i shes pa dang gsum bar do dang bsres pa'o// sems kyi ngo bo mthong na/ rang rig pa'i ye shes shes bya/ bden pa mthong ba zhes bya/ lus sems can/ sems sangs rgyas yin par gsungs te/ thams cad gnyis med rtogs gyur na// sa dang lam gyi khyad par yang*// rim par dbye zhing 'byed du med// dug gsum dang ni ma bral bar// mya ngan 'das pa'i sa la gnas// sgrib pa rnam par ma dag par// thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes 'thob// ces so// 'o na sangs rgyas dang khyad par ci yod ce na/ zla ba tshes pa dang zla ba nya ba gnyis zla bar gcig kyang*/ yon tan mi mnyam pa bzhin du/ chos nyid rtogs pa'i phyir sangs rgyas yin par 'dra yang*/ yon tan mi mnyam ste/ rnal 'byor pas da rung du rnam rtog ma spangs te/ des bskyed pa'i bdag tu 'dzin pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa dang*/ bde sdug la sogs pa yod pas/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan gang yang mngon du ma gyur ro// sems de mnyam bzhag la snang ba tsam mo// 'o na bskal pa grangs med pa gsum gyis sangs rgyas pa ci'i phyir zhe na/ rtogs par ni sla'i/ rnal mar rtogs pa 'byor pa shin tu dka'o// rnam rtog dang sgrib pa rim pas sbyangs sam cig car sbyangs zhe na/ mdo dang bstan bcos phal che las/ grangs med pa gsum gyis sbyangs zhes bya'o// cig car du dag pa yang yod do// gang zag bsags pa rgya che ba/

skal pa dang ldan pa/ shes rab che ba/ zab cing rgya che ba la mos pa ni/ mtshan ma med pa'i ting (18ba)'dzin bsgoms pas cig car du sbyangs te/ chos dang gang zag bdag med dang*// khyod kyi nyon mongs shes bya rnams// mtshan ma med pas rtag tu dag /ces pa dang*/ sgron me chung ngus mun pa chen po dus cig la sel ba bzhin du/ bskal pa mang por bsags pa'i las dang nyon mongs pa yang rtogs pa gcig gis sel lo// zhes pa dang*/ dge bsnyen btsun pa nga lus ma rabs kyang*/ sems sangs rgyas so// gnas ngan len gyi sgrib pa ni/ bskal pa grangs med pa gcig gam/ tshe gcig gam/ lo gcig gam/ zla ba'am/ zhag gam/ tho rangs sam/ thun gcig gam/ skad cig /thengs gcig gis sbyangs zhes gsung ngo*// bla ma rtogs ldan zhig gis slob ma skal ldan tshe 'di blos btang ba gcig 'khrid na/ dang por dbang gis smin par byed/ de nas smin pa grol bar byed pa'i thabs bskyed rdzogs gnyis la slob pa yin te/ bskyed rim ni lha'i sgyu ma lta bu bsgom pa yin/ rdzogs rim ni spros bcas rtsa rlung yin/ spros med ni 'od gsal ba'i sems stong pa nyid yin/ de la ma yengs par bsgoms pas rang la nges shes skyes/ sems kyi ngo bo ma shor na rnam rtog phra mo byung yang mi lto// nam mkha'i sprin ltar rang zhir 'gro// gnas pa yun ring ba la yon tan du mi blta/ gzugs med du skye nyen yod/ de ltar dben par bskyed rdzogs gnyis bsgoms pas yon tan brgyad 'byung ste/ rtags du ba lta bu 'byung na/ rlung dang snang ba 'gags nas rlung dhū tir tshud pa yin/ lus thams cad bde ba dang sems dga' ba 'byung*/ lus khol bur bde ba dang*/ gzhog phyed bde ba dang*/ bde ba mi snyoms pa ni rtsa gnas gzhan du rlung zin pa yin/ rtags gnyis pa shar na/ snang ba nyams su myong ba 'ong ste/ phyir snang (19na)ba 'di la mi zer/ sems nyid nyams su myong ba yin/

rtags gsum pa 'byung na gsal la mi rtog pa'ong ste/ rlung sems su chud pa yin/ rtags bzhi pa shar na/ lta ba 'di don dang chos thams cad rig cing gsal ba dang*/ phrin las bzhi 'grub/ lta ba'i don ni sems nyid la blo nges pa'o// rig cing gsal ba 'khor 'das thams cad 'od gsal du 'char ba'o// phrin las bzhi 'grub pa ni/ bsnyen pa bya mi dgos par tshegs med du 'grub pa'o// bzhi pa zhi gnas mthar phyin pa ste/ rlung 'od gsal du tshud pa'o// lnga pa 'byung na lhag mthong gi shes rab skyes pa yin te/ ye shes kyi rtags lus 'ja' tshon nam/ 'od kyi gong bur mthong ba'am/ blta bya dang lta byed med par stong par 'ong ba'o// spyir theg pa chen po ni pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ gsang sngags gnyis yin/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam ni/ dang por skyabs su 'gro ba thun mong ba blangs nas/ bslab bya brgyad la slob/ de nas skyabs 'gro khyad par can sngon du song bas/ smon pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ bslab bya lnga la slob smon pa sgrub thabs su byas nas/ yan lag bdun gyi sgo nas sbyong ba yin/ de nas 'jug pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do// bslab bya tshul khrims gsum la slob/ sems drug gi sgo nas bslab bya rnam pa gsum sbyong ba yin/ de ltar bslab pa gsum la bslabs pas rnam smin dang rgyu mthun brgyud nas 'gro ba yin te/ tshogs lam dang sbyor lam du/ rnam smin 'bras bus dal 'byor gyi lus brgyud/ mthong lam 'dzam bu gling gi bdag por 'gyur/ sgom lam nas lha'i lus brgyud/ sa bcu par dbang phyug chen po skye/ gzhan snang yin/ bral ba'i 'bras bu tshogs lam du 'jig rten chos brgyad (19ba)dang 'bral/ sbyor lam du gzung 'dzin gnyis dang 'bral/ mthong lam du mthong spang dang 'bral/ sgom lam du bsgoms spang dang 'bral/ sa bcu rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin thob nas/ las srid pa'i sa bon kun gzhi rnam shes la 'gags nas/

skad cig ma gnyis la bcu gcig kun tu 'od kyi sa la bde ba chen po chos kyi sku dus thams cad du chad pa med pa/ nam mkha' ltar thams cad la khyab pa mngon du gyur/ smon lam gyi dbang gis gdul bya las dag pa la gzugs sku'i snang ba 'char ro// gnyis pa/ gsang sngags kyi lam de ji 'dra yin zhe na/ dang por ma smin pa smin par byed pa la dbang bskur te/ bum pa'i dbang gis lus ngag yid gsum lha'i sku gsung thugs su bskyed/ nyon mongs pa lnga ye shes rnam pa lngar bskyed/ lus dben pa bsgrub/ gsang ba'i dbang gis rang la yod pa'i bde ba bskyed par byed/ ngag dben par bsgrub/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gis zag pa med pa'i bde ba bskyed par byed/ sems dben par bsgrub/ bzhi pa rin po che tshig dbang gis sems kyi stong nyid chos sku spros pa'i dra ba mtha' dag dang bral ba/ bde ba chen po'i sku chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes ngo sprod par byed pa yin/ de nas rtsa ltung dang bla ma lnga bcu pa nyan/ de nas grol bar byed pa'i lam dang po bskyed rim ston/ de nas rdzogs rim spros bcas rtsa rlung la sogs pa ston/ de nas rdzogs rim spros med mthar thug ston/ de bsgoms pas ting nge 'dzin 'byung*/ nang rtags bzhi 'char la/ zhi gnas mthar phyin pa 'jig rten pa'i bsam gtan yin/ rtags lnga pa shar bas zhi gnas dang lhag mthong zung 'jug tu 'brel ba yin/ drod rtags gsum 'byung ste/ phyi'i drod lus yod pa mi tshor ba dang*/ nang gi drod dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba mi tshor ba dang*/ gsang ba'i drod rtog med (20na)kyi bde ba 'byung ba'o// de bsgom pa'i 'od gsal yin/ 'chi khar bar do 'dzin pa'i gdams ngag la brten nas/ bsam gtan gyi 'od gsal dang rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal bsres te/ bde ba chen po'i sku mngon du byed pa yin gsung*/ chos dang chos nyid dang blo'i don ci zhe na/ chos ji lta ba ni rang gi rig pa byang chub kyi sems so// chos nyid ji lta ba ni de thog ma rgyus ma bskyed/

tha ma rkyen gyis mi 'jig pa/ ye nas rnam par dag pa/ ma bcos rang byung ye shes so// blo ji lta ba ni/ lta ba ji lta bar rtogs pa bzhin du/ gang du yang mi sems mi rtog par/ mnyam pa chen po'i ngang du ma bcos par bzhag /bcos shing bsgom du med/ ye shes ngang la gnas pa'o// de las mtshan ma'i cho 'phrul ci byung yang*/ don la g.yos pa dang 'gyur ba med pas/ dgag sgrub mi byed/ rang byung du shes pa ma yengs par gnas par bsgom pa'o// bying rgod 'byung na yang mnyam nyid ngang du tshor ba'o// nam zhig gdon la rig gyur na// rang rig kho na tsam du zad// rang rig de yang 'di snyam du// gzhan la bstan cing brjod du med// ces so// ngo sprod lnga ste/ gnyid dang rmi lam gyi dpes snang ba sems su ngo sprad/ chu dang chab rom gyi dpes snang stong dbyer med du ngo sprad/ nam mkha' stong pa'i dpes sems nyid stong par ngo sprad/ bu ram ril bu'i dpes du ma ro gcig tu ngo sprad/ chu bo rgyun chags kyi dpes chos sku rgyun chags par ngo sprad do// sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa yang lnga la/ rtogs pa ye shes su ldang ba'i dgongs pa nags la me mched pa lta bu/ mtshan ma rang sar grol ba'i dgongs pa mtsho la 'khyag pa zhu ba lta bu/ snang stong dbyer med kyi dgongs pa sngar 'dris kyi mi dang phrad pa lta bu/ ye shes spyi spungs kyi dgongs pa nyi ma'i snying po lta bu/ ting nge 'dzin ldang 'jug med pa'i dgongs pa rin po che gser gling du phyin pa lta bu'o// jo (20ba)bo rje'i bka' brgyud 'dzin pa rnams/ gsal ba/ mi rtog pa/ phra ba/ zhi ba dang bzhi ldan la rtsis che/ bde ba la rtsis chung*/ zhen gyis dogs so// gsang sngags pa thabs kyis bde ba bsgrub/ de las mi rtog pa skye/ rtsa dang rlung la sbyangs na shes pa la dbang thob/ phri bsnan btub pa'o// bde ba gsal ba mi rtog pa 'byung*/ rje btsun mi la la dris pas/

de tsug 'ong ba yin/ rtsa rlung bsgom pa khong gsung ba de la des kyang nyon mongs pa mgo non tsam 'ong ste/ des lam mi chod gsung*/ de la rtsis su mi mdzad/ sems nyid kyi ngo bo nges pa la rtsis che/ sems kyi ngo bo bde ba gsal ba mi rtog pa/ stong pa/ 'gyur ba med pa/ rgyun chad pa med par shes na snang la nges pa yin/ sems su ma shes na snang la ma nges pa 'jig rten pa'i lta ba yin/ gal te yid du 'ong ngo snyam pa'i sems// snying la 'phangs pa gces par byas pa yi// til gyi shun pa tsam gyi zug rngus kyang*// 'gro rnams sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig skyed par zad// ces gsungs/ bde ba la mchog tu bzung nas rgyun bsring na 'dod khams kyi lhar skye/ gsal ba la chags na gzugs khams su skye/ mi rtog pa ltengs pos gzugs med du skye/ nyan thos bde la gzhi byas te/ mtshan ma nyams myong gi chos yin/ mchog 'dzin mi byed stong par lta/ byang chub sems dpa' de la gzhi byas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rtsal sbyong*/ nyams su myong ba de rnam par rtog pa yin/ rnam rtog rang gi sems ye shes su 'khyer ba yin/ gnas pa rkyang pas lam mi chod/ de ni brgyal ba dang chang gis ra ro ba la yang yod de/ rtog pa dkar dmar sna tshogs ci snang yang*/ rig pa yin/ gsal bar nyams su myong ba yin/ rang gi rig pa rang bzhin gyis ma grub (21na)par nges na rtogs pa'o// gnas pa 'byung na bsgom pa yang rtog med du rgyun bsring ba yin/ ngo bo mthong nas de'i rgyun bsring na chod ma chod gnad ma go ba yin/ gdod ma nas rgyun chad ma myong ba yin/ rtogs pa dang ldan pa'i tshul snang ba sems su shes pa dang*/ sems ni ngos bzung dang bral ba nam mkha'i dkyil ltar phyam me ba'i nyams la brten nas brtan par byed/ de nas mtshan bcas bsgom mi dgos/ sems kyi glang po rnyed phyir ro// 'khor 'das kyi rtsad de gang du chod ce na/ rtogs ldan gyi bla ma dam pas/

skal ldan gyi slob ma la rig pa dang mi rig pa gnyis su ngo sprod pa yin te/ de bsgoms pas nyams su myong ba'i don la rtogs pa skye'o// nyams su myong ba ni rig pa spros bral du shar ba/ zag pa med pa'i bde ba dang ldan pa 'byung ba'o// dogs pa ni sems can la ma rig pa nyid nges pa thob pa'o// sems kyi sgyu ma mthong ba de yod pa ma yin te/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyis kyang ma gzigs/ med pa ma yin te/ nyams su myong ba de sangs rgyas kyis kyang mi khegs pa'o// mtshan nyid dang*/ rang bzhin/ ngo bo gsum ni/ mtshan nyid sna tshogs su snang ba'o// rang bzhin rig pa gsal la ma 'gags pa'o// ngo bo ni de'i don nyams su myong ba'i ye shes so// rgyud chen cig nas thabs gtso cher bshad/ tshan cig nas shes rab gtso cher bshad de/ blo dman pa'i dus su thabs gtso che ba man ngag yin te/ blo yar song nas shes rab gtso che ba yin/ de yang thabs la brten nas shes rab gtso che bar shugs kyis 'gro/ snang ba dang rnam rtog ma bcad par rang shugs kyis 'gags nas 'gro// bka' gdams pa lta ba la rtsis che ste/ grub mtha'i lta ba 'di ltar lags zer ba de la (21ba)rtsis mi che/ lta bas bltas pas stong par mthong ba la rtsis che/ bla ma mi la yang lta ba grub mtha' 'di ltar lags zer ba la rtsis mi che/ rang shar la rtsis che/ bsgoms pa las ma byung ba'i lta ba dka' gsung*/ lta ba gtan la dbab thabs ni/ rtsa rlung 'khor lo rtsis su che gsung*/ chos thams cad nang nas nyams thog nas smra ba zhig dgos gsung*/ nang nyams thog nas bltas na grub mtha' gang gis kyang ma phog /sems tsam pa rang rig rang gsal du 'dod pa dang*/ dbu ma pa'i skye med dang*/ sngags kyi stong pa nyid kyis kyang ma phog /phyi nas bltas nas ngag tu brjod na/ grub thob kyis gsungs pa'i grub pa sde bdun dang*/ rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa'i rgyud dang mi 'gal ba yin/

rgyu lam 'bras bu gsum gyi don ni/ bskyed dang 'phel byed rdzogs pa ste/ rig pa byang chub sems dang bskyed rdzogs dang sku gsum yin no// ma rig pa dang sdig pa'i las dang*/ ngan song gsum yin gsung*/ rnam par rtog pa la phra ba dang rags pa gnyis yin te/ rags pa ni snod bcud a 'thas su 'dzin pa yin/ phra ba skad cig sna tshogs su 'gyur ba'o// de nyid ngo bo gcig la mtshan nyid bzhi ste/ yid dang*/ rig pa/ sems/ rlung dang bzhi yin/ yul 'dzin pas na yid/ de go zhing rtogs par byed pas na rig pa/ de'i don gsal la ma 'gags pas sems/ rtsa rlung la rten cing sdud pas na rlung yin/ spyir gsang sngags zab mo 'di gdams ngag nyams su blangs pa/ nyams myong*/ rnal 'byor pa'i lus gsum po 'di sbas na legs pa yin/ gsang sngags gsang bar bshad pa yin/ ma gsang na dngos grub 'chor ba yin/ nyams myong yang bla ma la smra ba yin/ (22na)grogs blo 'dres pa dam tshig gtsang ma la smras kyang mi sto ba yin gsung*/ yang rin po che'i zhal nas/ ngas ni de snga yang ma gsang*/ da yang mi gsang*/ nges pa'i shes pa en tsam pa 'di cig kyang 'char 'chor mi 'dra/ nyams myong 'chor yang mi srid de/ khyod rang gar 'gro ba song gsung*/ bla ma rnams kyis sku nyams su bstar nas gsungs pa dang*/ bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis rang la nges pa'i shes pa en tsam pa/ bla ma'i yon tan ba spu brgyar bshags pa'i tshod tsam pa de la brten nas/ khyed la shes pa ngo sprod pa yin/ 'o cag 'khor 'das dang sangs rgyas sems can kho na zer ba de/ rig pa ngo shes ma shes yin/ sangs rgyas lnga 'dril gang yin lag pa'i lto rgyab yin/ de bas na nang du bltas pas dang por rig pa gsal sing nge ba 'byung*/ de rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor yin/ de bla ma la gsol ba drag tu btab cing bsgoms pas/ sdig pa zad nas rig pa spros bral du 'char te/ dga' rgyu med par dga' ba yin/

sngon ma rnyed pa rnyed/ dbul pos gter rnyed pa dang 'dra/ blo ma btang bar snang ba sems su chod pa'o// snang ba dgag sgrub dang phral ba lung ma bstan du 'gro/ snang ba la rjes ther ba min pa nyams la rgyun chad med/ bsgoms kyang 'ong*/ ma bsgoms kyang 'ong*/ don la mnyam bzhag dang rjes thob med pa yin/ en tsam brtan pa thob nas/ snang ba res stong pa/ res sgyu mar 'char/ res 'gag /rtog pa spra spro 'ong ste/ dran pa rang gar song cha med du 'gro gsung ngo*// //mar yul pa la pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam dang*/ gsang sngags kyi lam thams cad ji ltar mchis zhus pas/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i rnam thar tshogs lam/ zad (22ba)par sbyor lam/ zil gnon mthong lam/ de dang gsang sngags kyi lam ston pa rab 'bring tha ma rnam pa gsum thad so yin/ rgyal po gzhon nu'i spyod pa rnam smin la 'dzem/ zhi ba dul ba/ spyod lam mdzes pa/ gzhan ci dang ci byed pa dang tshogs lam thad so yin/ de nas bskyed rim la brtan pa cung zad thob nas/ gsang ba sngags kyi spyod pa byed pa drod cung zad thob pa na/ de'i tshe gsang ba'i spyod pa bya/ de'i tshogs dang dgon pa bogs gang thon lta ba res 'jog spyod pa byed pa yin/ tshogs su 'gro ba'i tshe ming la sogs pa gsang nas byed pa ste/ gsang spyod dang sbyor lam thad so yin/ rang rig gzhan rig gnyis su med par rig pa 'jig rten pa'i rnam rtog brtul nas/ gzhan don du 'gyur na bsad gso dang*/ 'gugs byed mkha' la 'gro rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa byed pa ni/ sa dang po'i thad so yin/ mnyam bzhag chen po'i spyod pa dang*/ mthong lam thad so yin gsung ngo*// byang chub sems dpa'i lam dang thad so bltas rtsi zhus pas/ bsgoms pa'i don phul zhig gsung*/ dben par sems rtse gcig pa la dka' ba med na tshogs lam thad sor yin/ tshogs kyi nang du sems rtse gcig pa la dka' ba med na sbyor lam thad so yin/

mnyam bzhag dang rjes la khyad med na sa dang po'i thad du nye ba yin gsung*/ pha rol tu phyin pa dang gsang sngags kyi khyad ci zhe na/ pha rol tu phyin pa don spyi'i rnam pa yul du byed pa yin/ chos thams cad gtan tshigs kyis gzhigs nas ma grub par byed/ nam mkha' rnam par dag pa'i dkyil ltar stong par byas de la blo 'jog pa yin/ gsang sngags pa ni don dngos lam du byed pa yin te/ thabs lam drag tu bcun pas rlung dhū tir (23na)tshud pa 'ong*/ rlung sems gnyis su med pa'i gnad kas/ de'i dus su gsal la mi rtog pa bde ba 'byung*/ de tsa na bla mas khyod kyi shes pa 'di rang sems rang rig pa stong pa nyid rang 'di yin no zhes ngo sprad pas/ slob mas kyang de ltar bsgoms pas snga ma'i nyams myong la mchog 'dzin dang bral te/ des rang gi sems gnyug mar nges pa 'ong*/ rig pa gsal ba bde stong yin la/ de las ma yengs pa de ting nge 'dzin yin/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin mthar phyin pa ni chos kyi sku'o// yang pha rol tu phyin pa ni sgro 'dogs gcod pa ste/ phyi gzung ba'i yul gcig dang du bral gyis gzhigs nas stong par byed/ gzung ba med na der 'dzin med zer nas/ gzung ba'i yul rtsad chod nas 'dzin pa sgrog rang brdal du 'gro zer nas/ nang 'dzin pa sems la rtog dpyod mi gtong ngo*// gsang sngags pas sgro 'dogs nang nas gcod pa ste/ yul la rtog dpyod mi gtong*/ rgyas 'debs byed pa'o// nang 'dzin pa'i sems la blta/ de bltas pas dang po ma skyes/ tha ma mi 'jig /da ltar gang na yang mi gnas/ rang bzhin cir yang ma grub par nges pa 'ong*/ de yang ye shes kyi yul yang ma yin na/ rnam rtog gi blos ga la mthong*/ don gsal sing nge ba blo'i gting nas shar ba ni nyams myong*/ de las ma yengs pa gnas pa/ de dang po nas mi skye ba'i ngo bor shes pa rtogs pa yin/ bla mas ngo ma sprad na nyams de rgyun bsrings pas stong phyam phyam la 'gro ste/

stong pa had po ye shes phyal po yin pas lam du mi 'gro /zhen pa 'bral ba la dum re tsam phan pa tsam 'ong*/ de bas na thar pa'i lam du 'khrid pa de la/ bla ma nyams rtogs can dgos pa yin gsung*/ pha rol tu phyin pa mos pa lam du byed/ gsang sngags (23ba)pas byin rlabs lam du byed/ gzung ba'i yul la mi blta/ nang 'dzin pa'i sems rtsad gcod pa yin/ de yang bla mas ngo sprad na sgyu ma dang*/ gzugs brnyan la sogs pa yul bzhi dang bral ba bzhin du/ rang la ye nas yod pa'i sems nyid yod med thams cad dang bral bar ngo sprad nas/ rang gis bsgoms pas nges pa'i shes pa skye/ de'i don la rgyun bsrings pas sems kyi stong pa nyid mthong ba yin/ nges pa dang ma nges pa gnyis yin/ rtogs pa brtan na de rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rdo rje ye shes yin/ de ni rdo rje slob dpon yin te mi slu ba yin/ mchog tu gyur pa'i don rnyed pas grub mtha'i chos la 'dod pa mi 'ong*/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rnyed pas ban nga la 'dod pa mi yong ba dang*/ 'khor ba'i gzhi rtsa chod pa yin/ ma rig pa rang sar grol bas 'du byed la sogs pa thams cad 'gag pa yin no// spyir lam gsum la rjes dpag lam du byed pa ni/ chos thams cad gcig dang du bral gyis gzhigs nas/ rang bzhin med par byas nas 'gro sa 'di las med zer nas de bsgom pa'o// byin rlabs lam du byed pa ni lha'i sku bskyed pa'i rim pa la brten nas/ rtsa rlung la sogs pa sbyangs pa'o// mngon sum lam du byed pa gnyug ma phyag rgya chen po'o// yang lam gsum la/ gzhi spong ba'i lam ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa ste spang bya dang gnyen po tha dad du byas nas spong ba yin/ gzhi sgyur ba'i lam ni gsang sngags pa ste/ rten sgyur ba lus lhar bskyed/ brten pa sgyur ba dbang po rdo rje dang pad+mar byed/ chos thams cad sgyur ba nyon mongs pa lam du byed/ rtog pa ye shes su byed/

dri mas dri ma 'khrud/ rtog pas rtog pa gcod pa'o// gzhi shes pa'i lam pa ni phyag rgya chen po ste/ spang bya med gnyen po med bsgyur du med/ sgyur byed med (24na)de thams cad sems kyi cho 'phrul yin la/ sems nyid gdod ma nas skye ba med pa'i don/ chos sku rang chas su yod pa ngo shes mthong ba goms par byed pas sangs rgyas pa'o// yang gsum ste dbang po brtul po dad pa can tshogs kyi lam du 'jug pa ni pha rol tu phyin pa'o// 'bring rtog pa dang nyon mongs pa can thabs kyi lam du 'jug pa ni gsang sngags so// dbang po rnon po shes rab can de kho na nyid la 'jug pa ni phyag rgya chen po'o// zhi gnas dang lhag mthong ni/ chos thams cad kyi sgo'o// zhes gsungs pas/ de gnyis la don lnga ste/ rgyu dang*/ las dang*/ gegs dang*/ sgrib pa dang*/ lam yongs su dag pa'o// zhi gnas kyi rgyu tshul khrims rnam par dag pa/ lhag mthong gi rgyu thos bsam gyi shes rab bo// zhi gnas kyi lam ni mtshan ma'i 'ching ba las grol bar byed pa/ lhag mthong gi lam ni gnas ngan len gyi 'ching ba las grol bar byed pa'o// zhi gnas kyi gegs ni lus dang longs spyod la blta ba'o// lhag mthong gi gegs ni 'phags pa'i gtam gyis tshim pa ma thob pa'o// 'du 'dzir gnas pa dang cung zad tsam gyis chog par 'dzin pa ni gnyis ka'i gegs so// sgrib pa ni/ rgod pa dang 'gyod pa dang*/ the tshom gyis zhi gnas la sgrib/ gnyid dang rmugs pas lhag mthong la sgrib/ 'dod 'dun dang gnod sems kyis gnyis ka la sgrib pa'o// rmugs pa dang gnyid legs par choms pa ni zhi gnas kyi lam yang dag pa'o// rgod 'gyod legs par choms pa ni lhag mthong gi lam yongs su dag pa'o// de gnyis kyis sgrib pa gnyis legs par choms pas 'bras bu chos kyi sku rnam dag thob pa'o// stong pa nyid bsgom sngas pa'i skyon lnga la/ zab mo'i chos spyod (24ba)spong ba dang*/

tshig gi lta ba la brten nas las rgyu 'bras khyad du gsod pa dang*/ stong pa had pos nga rgyal dang khyad gsod skye ba dang*/ thabs dang 'bral bas nyan thos kyi lam du 'gyur bas/ do ha las/ snying rje dang bral stong pa nyid zhugs gang*// de yis lam mchog rnyed pa ma yin no// zhes gsung*/ stong pa nyid bsgom phyis pa'i skyon ni 'khor ba'i gzhi rtsa mi chod pas/ 'bros pa'i sa mi rnyed/ do ha las/ 'on te snying rje 'ba' zhig bsgom na yang*// 'khor ba la gnas thar pa thob mi 'gyur// zhes dang*/ lha la mchod pa khri phrag phul byas kyang*// de yis bdag nyid 'ching 'gyur ci zhig bya// de 'dras 'khor ba 'di ni chad min te// zhes pa'o// bsgom pa'i dus tshod mi shes pa'i skyon ni/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems tshad du phyin nas/ don dam byang chub kyi sems ma bsgoms na/ sa bon ma btab pa'i chos sku ye shes mi 'char ba yin/ stong pa nyid bsgom pa ma shes pa'i skyon rgyas 'debs su shor ba la sogs pa yin/ stong pa nyid kyi gol sa ma shes pa'i skyon/ lta ba'i gol sa dang sgom pa'i gol sa la sogs pa'o// rje btsun mi la'i zhal nas/ lta ba dris pas nga la lta ba med gsung*/ khyed lta ba'i phyir ma 'brang nyams su len pa'i phyir 'brongs/ stong pa la nor sa yod pa yin gsung*/ nor sa lnga las stong pa nyid rgyas 'debs su shor ba ni/ chos thams cad phyag rgya chen po nyid du shor bas dang po nas zung 'jug tu mi byed par/ dang por yod par bzung nas chos spyod nyams su len/ de nas stong pas rgyas 'debs pa rtag chad do// gnyen por shor ba ni/ nyon mongs pa skyes pa'i dus su/ de rang skye med du shes pa gnyen po yin pa la/ de ltar mi byed par nyon mongs pa spang byar byas (25na)nas/ de'i gnyen por stong pa nyid bsgom pa'o// lam du shor ba ni/ rig pa stong pa skye med chos sku rang chas su yod pa bzhag nas/

chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsgom pas chos sku thob par 'dod pa'o// shes bya'i gshis la shor ba ni/ chos thams cad rang sems yin/ sems la bltas pas chog pa de la mi blta bar/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong pa ye dag ye grol ye sangs rgyas pa yin/ bsgom rgyu ci yang med zer nas stong pa nyid la blo phyal gyis 'jog pa'o// stong pa nyid blos byas su shor ba ni/ sems skye med kyi ngang la ma bcos par bzhag pas chog pa la/ de ma shes par chos thams cad rig pas gzhigs nas/ nam mkha'i dkyil ltar byas nas de la stong par blo 'jog pa yin te/ shes pa stong phyam pa la blo 'jog pa yin gsung*/ 'o na stong pa nyid ma nor ba rnal ma de gang yin na/ sems nyid gnyug ma ma bcos pa/ rten gang yang ma bcas pa/ sgo gar yang ma 'gags pa/ mtha' gar yang ma lhung ba/ phugs gar yang ma gtad pa/ dmigs yul med pas re dwogs med pa/ zhe 'dod dang bral ba ste/ dpe gang gis mtshon du med/ brjod pa gang gis kyang thog tu mi phebs/ sangs rgyas la gsal bar snang*/ rnal 'byor pa la thabs dpag tu med pa la brten nas rang bzhin gyis byung ste/ de'i tshe rtog pa rang shugs kyis chod/ nyon mongs pa ngang gis 'gag /ye shes shugs kyis 'char/ lta ba rang shugs kyis rtogs/ tha snyad gang du yang mi thogs/ sems la nyams su myong ba las ngag tu brjod du ma btub ste/ gzhon nu ma'i bde ba myong ba'am/ lkugs pa'i rmi lam lta bu'o// sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa yi// ye (25ba)shes sems can kun la yod// dbul po'i gter bzhin phan ma thogs// rtogs par sla ste drung na 'dug /dka' ste ngos bzung thams cad bral// bsam pa'i yul las 'das pas so// rtogs pa'i thabs ni gang zhe na// tshogs bsags gsol ba gdab pa'o/ /na mo gu ru/ sems dang sems kyi 'od gnyis mi gda' na zhus pas/ de ltar yin/ snang ba sems su 'dus tsa na/

sems gcig pu las gzhan ci med pa yin gsung*/ chos sku dang chos sku'i 'od gnyis su mi gda'/ chos sku gcig pu las mi gda' na zhus pas/ de ltar yin/ chos sku gcig chod la song ba'i dus su chos sku gcig pu las med pa yin gsung*/ sprul sku sangs rgyas shāka thub lta bu de rnam smin gyi lus lhag ma yod pa don gcig chod la song ba yin nam zhus pas/ de ltar yin/ sku mya ngan las 'das nas skye ba dag pas rang snang la med gzhan snang la gzugs sku 'byung ba yin gsung*/ gzugs sku gnyis rang snang la med pa ste/ rang snang la gzhan don byed bzhin du byed pa'i rnam rtog med pa la zer ram/ 'on te rang snang la gtan med pa yin zhus pas/ de la lugs gnyis yin/ dge bshes bka' gdams pa rnams snga ma ltar 'dod pa yin/ 'o skol gyi bla ma phyi ma ltar 'dod pa yin/ gzhan snang la snang ba de yo mthun par 'dod pa yin/ gsung*/ don thog nas ma tshor bar yengs nas/ phyis dran pa rnyed tsa na/ don rnyed pa de'i bar du yengs pa'i rjes la bltas pas chos skur 'gro 'dug na/ des chog gam mi chog /bar der bsgrib par nus sam mi nus/ rtag tu ma yengs par bsgom mam mi bsgom zhus pas/ rjes la bltas pas chos sku chos skur 'gro na des chog /bar gyi rnam rtog gis bsgrib par ma (26na)nus/ gtan du ma yengs pa mi dgos/ yengs pa bya ba med pa yin/ gnas lugs la yengs ma yengs med pa yin gsung*/ bla ma rje btsun dang sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa 'di yin/ 'di las 'phul sa'am bogs 'don rgyu med par 'gro bas/ 'o na byas pa la/ shes rab kyi ni mig gis de mthong 'gyur// bya ba yin/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// rig pa dang por ngos zin pa ni/ nyams su blang ba'i thabs/ so ma lhug pa ma bcos par bzhag pa dang*/ de nas nyams su myong ba ni/ rnam rtog chos nyid du ro gcig tu myong ba dang*/ de nas rtogs pa ni/

khyab bdag rdo rje'i sku nyid dang*// mi 'gyur dus ni thams cad pa'o// zhes gsungs pas/ khyab pa nam mkha' dang 'dra ste/ skye med kyis phyi nang snod bcud yo la khyab/ rdo rje'i sku ni mi 'jig pa yin/ mi 'gyur ba ni gdod ma nas rang bzhin gyis lhun grub yin pas/ skye 'gag med pa'o// dus thams cad pa ni 'das pa dang*/ ma 'ongs pa/ da ltar ba lta bu ma yin te/ rgyun chad pa med pa'o// rtogs pa nam mkha' lta bur cir yang khyab// nyams myong spre'u dang 'dra ste gar yang 'gyur// gnyis med shes pa chu dang 'o ma 'dra// rang bzhin rnal ma glang po lta bur bsgom// 'gyur

ngo bo nyid la ba med pa yin/ dang zhes gsungs por rtogs pa/ bar ma yengs pa du 'dris/ tha ye shes nyid mar de klong du gyur nas sangs rgyas pa yin gsung*/ gnyis med du rbad kyis chod pa'i dus su/ rtse gcig la sogs pa yin/ ma rig pa la sogs pa gcig yin gsung*/ bsgom du yod byas kyang 'gal ba med/ ngo thams cad gcig tu bo rgyun chad med/ bsgom du med byas kyang (26ba)'gal ba med/ ngo bor grub pa med/ lar nang gi rten 'brel gyis phyi'i snang ba 'jig dgos pa yin/ 'gro drug gi sems can gyi ngo bo dang*/ 'phags pa gsum gyi ye shes dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs gsum gcig yin/ de la rtogs na sems can dang 'phags pa gsum gnas gyur pa yin/ ngo bo lhan cig skyes pa'i nyams ma gtogs pa/ nyams myong thams cad 'jig pa yin/ 'di dang phyi ma bar do gsum mnyam pa nyid du shes na/ bar do'i gdams ngag mi dgos/ 'od gsal ba ni rgyun par gnas// bar do'i grong khyer des mi mthong*// zhes gsungs pas/ sangs rgyas sems can gnyis med du rtogs na 'phags pa sdud pa'i de yin/ snying rje chen po bskyed kyang sems can 'du shes med/ ngo bo'i nyams rgyun chad med pa 'di kun rdzob yin na/ 'jig pa'i skyon yod/ don dam yin na bden pa mthong ba'i skyon yod/ rje btsun don dam du bzhed/ bde ba chen po dbyer med du bzhed/ bya yul bas kun rdzob tu bzhed/ bzhed kyang de las logs nas don dam mi 'tshol bas/ don mthun du 'dug /rgyu 'bras gcig yin pa'i gnad kas/ rgyu yod pa zhig la 'bras bu med pa zhig 'dod na chad lta yin/ mu stegs rtag chad gnyis dang khyad med/ gsang sngags tshe gcig lus gcig gis 'tshang rgya ba yin/ rten la bzang ngan med sdig la che chung mi rtsi/ ngo bo ma shar na sdig pa sbyang dgos/ sems la sdig pa yong ba yin/ ngo bo shar ba la sdig pa med pa yin/ sems tsam rig pa rtog ge'i yul las 'das pa gsal ba la 'dzin pa yod par 'dod pa yin/

sngags pa rig pa skye med du 'dod pa dang*/ gsal la 'dzin pa med pa yin/ ngo bo dus gsum gyi (27na)sangs rgyas kyis kyang ma gzigs/ gzigs par mi 'gyur/ mthong ba med/ dngos po dang mtshan ma'i ngos nas ngo bo skye 'gag dang bral ba/ rgyun chad pa med pa/ gsal la rtog pa med pa/ bde ba chen po ni gzugs shig yin na nam mkha'i khams su mi shong ba yin/ lan cig dbugs chad nas lus bor ba'i dus na/ mi rnams shi zer yang rang cag ngo bo dang ma bral bas/ shi ba med pa yin gsung*/ nyams kyi phyir ngo bo shor nas bde gsal 'byung na dga'/ ma 'byung na mi dga' na/ nyams phyir shor ba yin/ nyams ngan yang ngo bo ma 'gags na nyams te rtogs pas thob pa yin/ gnyid log tsa na yang ngo bo rgyun chad med/ rtog pa 'phro ba yin/ nyams rgyun chad kyang ngo bo la rgyun chad med pa yin/ snang grags thams cad gcig tu shar nas/ de'i ngang las ma yengs par bsgoms pa yang ngo bo yin/ yengs ma yengs mi rtsi/ chod che shos yin/ mnyam pa nyid yin gsung*/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ngo bo gzhi gcig pa'i ngos nas thams cad la khyab pa zhig 'dug /ngo bo yod med gnyis las 'das pa'i ngos nas khyab bya khyab byed med pa zhig 'dug /de gnyis ka yin gsung*/ skye med kyis thams cad la khyab pa zhig 'dug gsung*/ ngo bo mthong ba med pas khyab pa med pa yin gsung*/ rang gsal rgyun chad med pa 'di/ rnam smin gyi lus spangs nas gsal ba dag pa rgya cher 'gro ba yin/ da lta rnal 'byor pa lus rgya ma zhig pa yin/ zhi gnas da lta bas brgya log gis gsal la rgya cher 'gro ba yin/ pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ myong ba mi 'dod gsang sngags nyams myong 'dod gnyis kyi khyad ci yod na/ lam thams cad kyi khyad phyed pa yin nye ring la khyad (27ba)yod/ nā ro pa'i lugs kyi bsgom yod yin/ mai trī pa'i lugs kyi bsgom med yin/ lam gyi dus na bsgom yod yin/
