'bras bu'i dus su bsgom mi bsgom gyi rtsis gdab med/ chos thams cad gcig yin/ nyams dang rtogs pa gcig tu 'dod pa yin/ yod pa bzhin du med/ med pa tsam du med pa yin/ so so rang la nges shes yod kyang rtogs pa can la dris pas/ nam mkha' dang 'dra bar stong pa zhig 'ong ba yin/ sems kyi ngo bo'i don rtogs na lus bor ma bor med par mchog gi dngos grub thob pa yin/ lus bor bas bzang du mi 'gro ba yin/ gsang sngags pa la ma rtsi ba med pa yin/ gzugs sku gnyis kyi rtogs pa rgyun ma chad kyi ring la/ skad cig gis rang yi dam lhar bskyed pa de las 'byung*/ rtogs pa rang gis kyang 'ong ba yin gsung*/ dge ba yang byar med/ sdig pa yang shugs kyis mi byed pa yin/ da lta'i lus dang po'i ma rtogs tsa na'i lus yin pas/ bsod nams tshogs gsog dgos pa yin/ byams pa snying rje blos skul dgos ring la bsgom mnyam nyid ngang las ma yengs pa lam yin/ 'bras bu la yengs ma yengs kyi rtog dpyod med pa yin/ las dang po pa la snang ba dgrar 'char ba yin/ sgom chen 'bring la snang ba grogs su 'char ba yin/ sgom chen rab la snang mi snang gi rtsis gdab med pa yin/ dbu ma rig pas sgrub pa bya ba snang sems gcig tu 'dod pa yin te/ kun rdzob yod med gnyis dang bral ba'i snang ba tsam/ ming tsam de nyid nyams su len pa yin/ de nas rgyun chad na 'tshang rgya bar 'dod/ de bas bla ma'i mtho 'dug gsung*/ mthun snang gi skabs su sgyu ma tsam/ ming tsam la rtsi ba yin pas/ ya ki longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la bde (28na)ba ci yod pa dang*/ ma ki dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal gnyis mnyam pa min nam byas pa la yin zer/ 'o na yar tshogs gnyis gsog gam mi gsog /mar sgrib gnyis sbyong ngam mi sbyong byas pas lan ma thebs/ sgrib gnyis sbyong na khyad byung ba yin/ da ci'i mnyam pa'i dam bca' zhig pa yin/ longs sku yang ming tsam yin/

dmyal ba yang ming tsam/ yar tshogs gnyis gsog pa dang*/ mar sgrib gnyis kyang ming tsam yin/ rang gi sems kyi snang ba tsam yin/ de tsam du mnyam gsung*/ sngags kyi dbang du byas na phyag rgya chen po rtogs pa dang gcig /pha rol tu phyin pa'i dbang du byas na mthong lam skyes pa las yar skyed pa don rgyu med/ yar la 'phul na ji 'dra ma zhig gis 'phul/ thabs ci 'dra ba zhig gis 'phul rgyu med na gnad ka ci 'dra ma zhig gis med/ dbang po yang rab la gsang sngags/ pha rol tu phyin pa gang la yang rten med yin/ rnal 'byor pa yang rab cig la rtogs pa sangs rgyas dang khyad med pa yin kyang*/ yon tan la khyad yod pa yin/ dbu ma dang phyag rgya chen po man chad nas/ mu stegs yan chod cig chod du song ba zhig la dgag sgrub med pa yin/ ngo bo yod pa zhig la cis kyang bar du mi chod pa yin/ rang gi 'dzin stangs ma gtogs pa pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam rtags bshad kyang byung ba med pas drang don yin gsung*/ bskyed rim mchog dang thun mong gnyis ka'i rten yin gsung*/ gnyid rmi lam thabs shes/ 'od gsal shes rab yin/ snang ba thabs yin/ ngo bo bsgoms pas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i snying rjer 'gro ba yin/ snang ba rig pa byang chub kyi sems shor ba yin pas/ rang snang du ngo shes pas chog /cang bya mi dgos/ dam (28ba)tshig hril gyis dril na rtogs pa cig pur 'dus pa yin/ gdod ma nas gnas pa'i chos nyid 'gyur ba med pa yin/ ngo bo chos sku yin/ sangs rgyas pas bzang du mi 'gro ba yin/ dmyal bar song bas ngan du mi 'gro ba yin/ ngo bo rnal mar skyes pa'i shugs la gsal la mi khegs pa yin/ bar du mi chod pa yin/ ngo bo skyes pa la nyams yod pa yin/ myong byed 'gags pa yin/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa na bsam brjod las 'das pa yin/ sdom pa dang dam tshig thams cad sems su 'dus pa yin/ spong ba'i lam/ spyod pa'i lam/

sgyur ba'i lam/ gzhi shes pa'i lam mo/ /sgre pa'i zhal nas/ las rgyas sdom pa shor ba med/ sdig pa sbyong dgos so// bla ma'i zhal nas bre'i nang du phul bcug pa dang 'dra/ bla ma mar pa'i lugs kyis sdom pa gcig yin/ rin po che'i zhal nas/ sa dang po'i bden pa mthong nas zag med kyi sdom pa bya ba yin/ dge mi dge byed mkhan rang gcig pu yin/ ngo bo rtog med rang gsal yin/ mi 'gag pa yin/ gdod nas zhi zhing ma skyes dang shes rab snying po'i zab mo rnam brgyad kyis phog pa yin/ ngo bo rtog med des thams cad la khyab pa yin/ gnyid log pa'i dus dang*/ ra ro ba'i dus dang*/ brgyal ba'i dus dang*/ 'chi ba'i dus na yang rgyun chad med pa yin/ sngags nas gnyid chos skur bshad/ rmi lam sprul skur bshad/ gnyid ma log pa longs skur bshad kyang*/ don la rmi lam rnams rtog pa yin/ rtogs nas gtum mo la sogs pa bsgoms pas ngo bo rang yin/ ngo bo ma rtogs bar du gang bsgoms kyang rtog pa yin/ nyams thog tu ngo bo shor ba skyon chung shos yin/ de ltar sbyangs (29na)pas nges shes skyes nas grol/ rtogs pa'i thog tu nyams shor ba skyon che shos yin/ so sor thar pa'i rtsa ba bzhi byung yang gsang sngags kyi dam tshig la shor ba med/ gal te las kyi dbang gis 'chi gyur na/ rang byung ye shes yod ma yin/ sa chu la thim pas du ba lta bu zla ba shar ba la sogs pa bsgom mi dgos/ snang ba gsal la mched pa thob pa ngo bo rang yin/ rtog pa thams cad 'ubs kyis 'dus pa yin/ dran rig rgyun chad nas 'gro ba yin no// //na mo rat+na gu ru/ bar do rab 'od gsal gyis 'tshang rgya ba yin/ 'bring sgyu lus kyis 'tshang rgya ba yin/ tha ma mngal sgo bkag nas 'tshang rgya ba yin/ 'gegs pa la thabs mang yang 'ubs kyis bsdus na bskyed rdzogs gnyis yin/ yang na dag pa'i sgyu lus dang ma dag pa'i sgyu lus kyi sgo nas bar do ngos bzung*/

mngal skyes/ rdzus skyes/ sgong skyes/ drod gsher las skye ba rnams bskyed rim lha bsgoms pas/ lus gzhan mi len no// 'od gsal chos sku sems can thams cad la 'chi ba'i dus su yang yod de/ ngo ma shes na 'khor ba lugs dang mthun par 'byung ngo*// 'od gsal la snang ba/ snang ba las mched pa/ mched pa las rnam rtog spra yas 'byung ba de la 'khor ba zhes bya/ rigs drug tu mi 'khor ba'i thabs ni/ bdag 'chi ba yin pas 'od gsal chos sku la lo brgya'am/ stong du bsgom/ 'od gsal chos sku ngo shes na 'khor bar mi 'jug /gnyis med kyi ngang las ma yengs pas/ bar dor lus gsum dag nas 'od gsal 'ba' zhig tu 'gro ba yin/ 'khor ba la sred pa med pas len pa med do// 'khor ba lugs kyi bar do// skye shi bar dor/ (29ba)'dod chags 'khor ba yin pas bde ba dang bsre/ srid pa bar dor pha ma yab yum 'khor ba yin pas bla ma yab yum du bsgyur/ yon tan thams cad rdzogs pa'i bar dor ma dang bur bsre bas/ nam mkha' dang sems su bsre ba/ sems nyid chos nyid du bsre ba 'di lam yin/ 'bras bu la bsre bya dang sre byed las 'das pa yin gsung*// ༈ //bla ma dam pa'i zhal nas/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba nas mgo tshugs nas/ stong pa nyid rnal mar ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gcig 'tshol ba gal che// chos bya rgyu bsags sbyang gnyis las med/ sdig pa sbyang*/ bsod nams bsag /bsod nams bsags pas sdig pa sbyang*/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa 'od gsal ba 'di rgyu las ma byung ste/ lam rim la brten nas bsod nams bsag /byang chub kyi sems bsgoms pas 'di mthong ste 'ong bas/ rgyu las byung bar yang 'dug /'di rkyen las ma byung ste/ tshogs gnyis bsags pas 'di mthong ste 'ong bas rkyen las byung ba'i tshul du yang 'dug /'di thabs las ma byung ste/ bsags sbyangs rnam pa gnyis la brten nas/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems bsgoms pas 'di mthong ste 'ong bas/

'di thabs las byung ba'i tshul du yang 'dug /thabs bsgom dbang gis bdag nyid kyis// gang zhig shes rab rnams bsgoms na// des ni byang chub myur du thob// bdag med gcig pur bsgoms pas min// zhes pas de bas na bsod nams bsags pa gal che/ bsod nams gsog pa la bogs gang che na/ bla ma la bsnyen bkur byed pa bogs che gsung*/ po to ba dang spyan snga ba dang*/ rje btsun gsum gsung sgros re (30na)re gda' ste/ rje btsun ni sgrub pa'i mchod pa bsod nams che gsung bar gda'/ dang po zhi gnas skye ba'i rgyu bzhi la/ bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis skye ba dang*/ rten 'brel gyis skye ba dang*/ tshogs bsags pa las skye ba dang*/ sdig pa sbyangs pa las skye ba'o// sems nyid kyi ngo bo ma bcos ma bslad pa rnal ma de gsal la dag pa/ dus thams cad du rgyun chad pa med pa de yin te/ de la yang gnyis las/ snang la nges pa dang snang la ma nges pa'o// ston ka'i nam mkha' lta bu dang sems nyid gnyis su med par rtogs pa de snang la nges pa yin te/ yar sangs rgyas la mi re/ mar 'khor bar song gis dogs pa med/ gzhan gyis bsgyur yang mi 'gyur ba de snang la nges pa yin/ ma nges pa la yang nyams myong 'ong ste/ zhi gnas kyis bde ba dang mi rtog pa 'ong yang*/ nyams la res yin nam snyam/ res min nam snyam pa de mi rtog pas rgyu byas nas mar la ldog pa'i nyen yod/ gzugs khams sam/ gzugs med dam 'gog pa'i rgyur yang 'gro nyen yod gsung ngo*// dang por slob pa'i dus su rig pa gsal sing nge ba la bslab/ de yang rig pa'i ngo bo ma yengs pa la bslab/ de la goms tsa na rang la nges shes skye ba yin gsung*/ sems nyid kyi ngo bo de ma shor bar byas nas/ rnam rtog ci tsam 'phro ba yin/ rnam rtog yang chos sku yin/ dper na nam mkha' rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa yin yang*/ sprin dang na bun dang*/ khug sna la sogs pa ci tsam 'ong yang*/

nam mkha' rang la dengs nas 'gro ba dang 'dra/ de yang rnam rtog grogs su 'gro ba yang yin gsung*/ rnam rtog 'phror mi btub na slar thub yin/ gzugs med (30ba)du skye nyen yod/ yi dam lha'i bskyed rim rdzogs par yang res 'ga' bsgom gsung*/ skad cig dran rdzogs kyis yi dam gyi lhar bskyed nas/ 'od gsal 'ba' zhig bsgom pa yin gsung*/ de yang gsal sing nge ba de nyams myong yin/ de la ma yengs pa de gnas pa yin/ shes rab kyis bltas pas ci'i ngo bor yang ma grub pa de rtogs pa yin gsung*/ 'khor ba'i mtshan nyid mya ngan 'das// sems nyid yongs su shes pa ste// 'khor ba yongs su shes gyur na// de ni mya ngan 'das pa yin// 'khor ba'i rtsa ba ma rig pa yin pas de ngo shes na mya ngan las 'das pa'o// yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang gi zhal nas/ bsgom med sgom pa po yang med// gsung*/ rnal 'byor pa na re/ nga sangs rgyas la mi nyan sgom pa po yod/ ji ltar yod na rig pa nga rang yin/ nga'i ngo bo gsal la go ma 'gags pa/ rgyun chad pa med pa 'di sgom pa po yin/ nga'i ngo bo 'di sangs rgyas kyis gcod par mi nus/ bsgom pa yang nga rang yin/ bsgom par bya ba yang yod/ nga la nyams su myong ba en tsam yod/ 'o na yang sangs rgyas bden/ nga sangs rgyas kyi rjes su 'brang*/ sgom pa po med/ ji ltar med na nga ngos bzung mtha' dag dang bral bas/ de dpe dang tshig gang gis kyang mtshon du med/ mtshan ma'i ngos nas dus gsum sangs rgyas kyis kyang gzigs par mi 'gyur/ de'i ngo bo la sgom par bya ba'i yul med/ 'di ltar nyams su myong bya ba med pas/ bsgom par bya ba cung zad med/ nga bde gsal mi rtog gsum ka mi 'dod/ de ltar 'dod pa zug rngu yin/ dpe gang gis kyang mtshon du med/ tshig gang gis kyang thog tu mi phebs/ nga bcas bcos mi byed rang gar 'jog gsung ngo*// gsang sngags (31na)kyi lam ni bskyed rdzogs gnyis yin te/

de yang bskyed rim rab kyis zung 'jug gi rtogs pa sgrub/ 'bring dang tha ma gnyis kyis tha mal pa'i zhen pa bzlog /yang na rab kyis rang yi dam gyi lhar mthong*/ 'bring gis sgyu mar nges/ tha mas mos pa byed/ rdzogs rim rab kyis rang yid sangs rgyas su mthong*/ snang ba res sgyu ma/ res stong pa/ res rang las snang ba logs su ma mthong ste/ ro gcig gi rnal 'byor zhes bya/ 'bring gis ngo bo skye med du rtogs/ snang ba rang sar bkra lam me ba ste/ de spros bral gyi rnal 'byor zhes bya/ tha mas spros bcas la brten nas rtse gcig sbyong*/ gsal la ma 'gags pa'i skad cig ma'i shes pa/ rtse gcig ces bya'o// blo la ma nges na chos gang bshad kyang mi zab/ blor nges nas chos gang bshad kyang zab/ bka' gdams pa de rnams kyis gsang sngags mang du mkhyen kyang*/ skyes bu gsum la blo nges pas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa khong gis bzung*/ skyes bu gsum la blo nges nas byams pa snying rje byang chub kyi sems la man ngag tu go nas/ nyams su blangs pa las byung ba yin/ de bas na kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems rang bas gzhan gces pa 'di gal che/ 'di dang por mkho ste/ 'di med na theg pa chen po'i lam du mi chud/ bar du mkho ste 'di med na nyan thos par ltung*/ tha mar mkho ste 'di med na gzhan don sku gnyis mi 'byung*/ de bzhin du mi rtag pa bsgom pa 'di/ dang por mkho ste 'di med na tshe 'di las blo mi ldog /bar du mkho ste 'di med na rtag par bzung bas nyan thos la sogs par gol/ tha mar mkho ste mi rtag pa dang stong pa don gcig yin/ las dang 'bras bu 'di yang dang por mkho ste/ tshul khrims rnam (31ba)dag ngan 'gro 'gegs byed yin/ bar du mkho ste sgyu ma rmi lam tshogs gnyis rdzogs byed yin/ tha mar mkho ste kun rdzob mthar phyin gzugs sku rnam gnyis yin/ des na lam rim rtsis su che/

de tsho rgyud la ma skyes na gnyug ma rab rig cig skyes kyang*/ yul dang nye 'brel dang rdzas yo byad la chags nas gnyug ma des mi phan/ mar la 'gro ba las yar la mi 'gro /de bas na tshe 'di la chags par mi byed/ snang grags kyi chos 'di sgyu ma rmi lam lta bur blo nges su chug /byams pa snying rje byang chub kyi sems sbyongs/ de ltar nges na gnyug ma med kyang*/ kho yar la 'gro ba la/ mar la mi 'gro /gnyug ma rnal ma zhig rgyud la skyes na/ gnyug ma'i ngo bo/ gnyug ma'i 'bras bu/ gnyug ma'i rgyu gsum/ ngo bo ni med pa ma yin pa'i don skye 'gag thams cad dang bral ba de yin/ gnyug ma'i 'bras bu ni skye 'gag med par de nyid chos kyi sku yin/ de las gzugs sku gnyis 'byung*/ de yang gnyug ma'i nyams myong bde ba gsal ba mi rtog pa gsum las byung ba'i sku gsum gnyug ma'i 'bras bu yin/ bde ba/ gsal ba/ mi rtog pa de/ gtum mo las 'byung bas na gnyug ma'i rgyu yin/ gnyug ma skyes kyang*/ gtum mo med na shes rab rkyang pa yin/ gtum mo yod na thabs shes rab ya ma bral ba yin/ bla ma mi la'i zhal nas bsgoms las ma byung gi lta ba dka'/ gsung bas gtum mo la 'bad pa gal che gsung*// //ye shes rnam pa gsum ni/ 'di ka ltar bsgoms pas zhi gnas 'ong*/ de'i dus su nang rtags du ba lta bu'am/ srin bu me khyer lta bu 'ong*/ de ye shes cung zad la dbang ba bya ba yin/ de nas zhi gnas lhag mthong zung du (32na)'brel ba 'ong ste/ zhi gnas mthar phyin pa'i dus nang rtags mar me lta bu 'ong ste/ ye shes la dbang ba bya ba yin/ de nas sprin med pa'i nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu byung tsa na/ lhag mthong gi shes rab ces bya ste/ yang dag pa'i ye shes la dbang ba yin/ lus dpag bsam gyi shing la rtsa a ba dhū tir gnas/ de la 'khor lo rnam bzhi yod pa'i lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo na ye shes kyi rtsa 'dab ma drug cu rtsa gnyis yod/

de'i grong khyer na sems kyi rgyal po ti la ka bya ba bzhugs/ de zhal lta bar 'dod na skyes bu dad ldan bsod nams bsags pas/ shes rab kyi lde mig gis rnam rtog gi sgo lcags dkrogs nas sgo de phye nas zhal mthong ste 'ong*/ mthong na thun mong gi dngos grub dang mchog gi dngos grub gnyis ka 'dug /snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo na rtsa 'dab ma brgyad yod/ de la sems kyi rgyal po ba san+ta bzhugs/ gzhan gong mas 'gre /mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo na/ rtsa 'dab ma bcu drug yod/ de na yid kyi thig le bzhugs/ spyi bo bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo na/ rtsa 'dab ma sum cu rtsa gnyis yod/ de na ye shes kyi thig le bzhugs/ 'khor lo bzhi la gnad bzhi yod/ lte ba gtum mo'i gnad/ snying kha gnyid kyi gnad/ mgrin pa rmi lam gyi gnad/ spyi bo snyoms 'jug gi gnad/ rdo rje nor bu dang smin mtshams gnyis te drug go /de rnams gnad du 'ong ba ci ste zhe na/ de la shes pa'i rten yod pas gnad yin/ dmigs pa gtad thabs ni/ lte ba'i me la shes pa gtad pas/ rlung sems gnyis su med pa'i gnad kas/ rlung gis dkrugs pas rtsa sgo phye bas rlung a ba dhū tir tshud/ rlung dhū (32ba)tir tshud pas rtog med kyi ye shes 'bar/ de yang yul la dmigs pa ni shes rab la/ rlung gis rtsa sgo phyed pa ni/ shes rab kyis rnam rtog gi lcags phyed pa yin/ rtog med kyi ye shes 'char ba ni/ sems zhal mthong ba'o// snying rje rnam pa gsum ni/ sems can la dmigs pa dang*/ chos la dmigs pa dang*/ dmigs pa med pa'o// sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje ni/ so so skye bo rnams kyi sdug bsngal ma bzod nas/ de rnams kyi don du bdag sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa'o// chos la dmigs pa ni/ sa dang po yan chad kyi byang chub sems dpa' gzung 'dzin gnyis med du rtogs pa'o// dmigs pa med pa ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos sku thob pa'o// de phyi'i rnam pa yin/

rang la 'char ba'i dus su/ las dang por sems can gyi sdug bsngal ma bzod pa ni sems can la dmigs pa'o// de nas yang dag pa'i kun rdzob rmi lam du chod nas/ chos 'di ltar yin pa la 'di ltar ma rtogs pa dang*/ dngos po dang mtshan mar 'dzin pa snying re rje snyam pa ni chos la dmigs pa'o// de nas rang gi sems kyi de kho na nyid mthong nas/ smon lam gyi stobs kyi shugs kyis sems can gyi don 'byung ba ni dmigs pa med pa'o// stong pa snying rje'i snying po can ni/ dang por stong pa bsgoms nas de 'phro la snying rje bsgoms pas/ stong pa phyi la ma lus sam zhe na/ ma lus te/ stong pa sgom mkhan yang rig pa yin/ snying rje sgom mkhan yang rig pa yin pas tha dad med pa'o// dang por stong pa bsgoms nas/ de nas snying rje bsgoms pas/ stong pa snying rje'i snying po can zhes bya'o// dang po snying rje bsgoms nas de 'phro la stong pa bsgom pa/ snying (33na)rje stong pa'i snying po can no// tha dad med pa gong dang 'dra'o// dngos po/ ngo bo/ mtshan nyid gsum ni/ dngos po gzugs su grub pa thams cad do// ngo bo ni de'i rang bzhin stong pa'o// mtshan nyid ni dbyibs dang kha dog la sogs pa'o// yang snang la nges pa dang ma nges pa'o// snang ba ni/ bde ba/ gsal ba/ mi rtog pa sems kyi ngo bo yin te/ snang ba zhes bya de nyid sems kyi ngo bo rgyun ma chad par shes pa ni snang la nges pa'o// bde ba gsal ba mi rtog pa snang yang de nyid sems su ma shes na ma nges pa'o// ma nges pa de 'jig rten gyi mthar thug gi lta ba yin te/ bde gsal mi rtog pa gsum la mchog 'dzin byas pas/ khams gsum du gol/ nyan thos kyis gzhi de la byas nas/ de mtshan ma yin pas de nyams myong yin pas mchog 'dzin du mi lta bar stong pa nyid du 'dod/ byang chub sems dpa' de la gzhi byas nas ting nge 'dzin gyi rtsal sbyong ba yin/

de la ma zhen par 'dod khams kyi rtog pa yar blangs nas/ rnam rtog de nyid rig par khyer/ rig pa de sems su 'khyer ba ni ting nge 'dzin gyi rtsal sbyong ba'o// tha mal gyi shes pa/ ma bcos pa/ gnyug ma gsum gang zhe na/ tha mal gyi shes pa ni/ dang po'i shes pa grub mtha' gzhan gyis blos ma bsgyur ba'o// ma bcos pa ni bcas bcos mi bya bar rang gar gtong ba'o// gnyug ma ni de'i don ma skyes shing mi 'gag la rgyun chad pa med pas na gnyug ma'o// len pa'i rnam par shes pa zab cing phra// sa bon thams cad chu bo'i rgyun bzhin 'bab// bdag tu rtog par gyur na mi rung zhes// 'di ni byis pa'i skye bo rnams la ngas ma bstan// zab pa ni gting dpag (33ba)dka' bas na zab/ yang na rgyu 'di las 'bras bu 'di 'byung gi las 'bras shin tu phra bas na/ thams cad mkhyen pas mkhyen pa las gzhan gyis mi shes pas na zab/ phra ba ni mi mthong ba'o// sa bon chu bo bzhin du 'bab pa ni/ bag chags kyi sa bon rnams dang po gang las 'byung na/ rnam par shes pa las byung*/ yul gar btab na rnam par shes pa la btab/ 'bras bu gar smin na rnam par shes pa la smin/ ji ltar gnas na dper na gro ga la ra dkar mo'i 'o mas yi ge bris na gro ga dang yi ge tha dad med/ rkyen dang phrad na yi ge lam gyis 'ong ba bzhin du/ bag chags kyi sa bon rnam par shes pa la btab na/ rnam shes dang bag chags tha dad med/ dge sdig gi rkyen dang phrad pa'i dus su sngar gyi bag chags langs te 'bras bu bde sdug 'ong ngo*// de yang 'khrul pa'o// dbyings dang ye shes gnyis gang zhe na/ dbyings shes bya ba ni 'khor 'das thams cad kyi mtshan nyid do// ye shes shes bya ba ni sems nyid rnam par dag pa 'od gsal ba'o// chos chos can chos nyid gsum ni/ chos ni 'khor ba'i blo'i yul du gyur pa'o// chos can ni der 'dzin pa'i shes pa'o// chos nyid ni gdod ma nas ma grub pa'i rnam par dag pa'o//

//rin po che'i zhal nas/ dad pa gal che gsung*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'tshol ba yang dad pa yin/ dad pa la rnam pa gsum yin te/ rab kyis yid ches pa'i dad pa bsgom/ 'bring gis 'dod pa'i dad pa bsgom/ tha mas dang ba'i dad pa bsgom gsung*/ yid ches pa'i dad pa ni/ rgyu 'bras la yid ches pa'o// 'dod pa'i dad pa ni/ bden pa bzhi la brten nas skye/ dang ba'i dad pa ni (34na)yul khyad par can la brten nas skye/ dad pa brtan par byed pa yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin gsung*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen med na dad pas sdig pa'i grogs po dang 'phrad pa yin/ de bas dge ba'i bshes gnyen gal che ba'i tshul du 'dug /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rgyud dkrugs/ lung bcugs/ man ngag thugs la gab pa/ rgyud kyi nang na mar dang po brjod bya bstan nas/ de nas bskyed rim 'chad/ de nas rdzogs rim 'chad/ de nas yan lag bdun pa 'chad de/ rgyud dkrugs pa bya ba yin/ slob dpon mkhas pa rnams kyis lung bsdu ba'i bstan bcos dang*/ lung bkrol ba'i bstan bcos bya ba gsungs te/ lung bkrol ba'i bstan bcos bya ba 'grel ba dang*/ ṭī kā la sogs pa yin/ lung bsdu ba'i bstan bcos bya ba sgrub thabs yin te/ sgrub thabs kyang man ngag gab pa yin gsung*/ sangs rgyas kyis ji skad gsungs pa bzhin nyams su blangs kyang bla ma med na byin rlabs mi 'byung gsung*/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// bla ma la yang phyag 'tshal lo// phyag kyang sngon la bla ma la 'tshal/ mchod pa yang sngon la bla ma la 'bul/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas tha dad pa ma yin te/ bla ma dang ni rdo rje 'dzin// tha dad par yang mi brtag go /de yang chos thams cad bsdu na/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems gal che gsung*/ de yang goms pa las skye ba dang*/ bsgoms pa las skye ba dang*/ rtogs pa las skye ba gsum yin gsung*/ goms pa las skye ba bya ba tshe snga ma phan chad sbyangs pa las skye ba yin/

bsgoms pa las skye ba dang*/ rtogs pa las skye ba gnyis (34ba)'dra gsung*/ rtogs pa las skye ba bya ba sbyangs pa can gyi gang zag la/ sa ha dza 'od gsal ba/ zag med kyi stong nyid mngon sum du mthong bya ba yin gsung ste/ byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis phan tshun ltos pa'i chos can yin gsung*/ dge bshes rgya yon bdag gi zhal nas/ bod na nom bu kha na mngar ba'i chos pa mang po zhig yod de/ rdzogs pa chen po ba zer ba gcig /nang rtogs na nang 'tshang rgya// nub rtogs na nub 'tshang rgya zer ba tshan gcig yod/ mtshan nyid pa zer ba gcig /gcig dang du bral gyis gzhigs nas nga'i 'dis 'tshang rgya zer ba tshan gcig yod/ pha rol tu phyin pa zer ba thabs dang shes rab la brten nas nga'i 'dis 'tshang rgya zer ba tshan gcig yod/ sngags pa zer ba'i rtsa rlung thig le dang*/ bskyed rdzogs la brten nas nga'i 'dis 'tshang rgya zer ba tshan gcig yod/ bka' gdams pa zer ba'i skyes bu rab 'bring rnam pa gsum la brten pa'i gdams ngag nga'i 'dis 'tshang rgya zer ba tshan gcig yod de/ de tsho yo log nas ci byed nga la zlos dang gsung*/ de tsho yo log nas mi dge ba bcu dge ba bcur bsgyur ba las gzhan med gsung*/ blo che ba rnams kyis zag bcas kyi dge ba zag med du bsgyur ba yin gsung*/ mi dge ba bcus nga la mi gos zer ba tshan gcig yod de/ de sdig pa'i grogs po yin gsung ngo*// chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong du gsungs kyang*/ 'ub kyis bsdus na lus ngag yid gsum du 'dus/ de yang lus ngag gnyis kyang 'khor yin/ gtso bo sems yin gsung*/ mi dge ba skad cig kyang mi rgyu bar bya/ gnyen po'i sgo nas lung ma bstan du yang ma shor bar bya gsung ngo*// rin po che'i zhal nas lam rnam pa gsum du 'gro dgos gsung ngo*// (35na)rjes dpag lam du byed pa dang*/ byin rlabs lam du byed pa dang*/ mngon sum lam du byed pa gsum yin gsung*/

mtshan nyid dam pha rol tu phyin pa ni rjes dpag lam du byed pa bya ba yin/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags ni bskyed rdzogs gnyis la brten nas byin rlabs lam du byed pa yin/ mngon sum lam du byed pa ni lhan cig skyes pa 'od gsal bya ba yin gsung*/ lam gsum la 'jug pa'i gang zag ni gnyis te/ rim gyis pa dang*/ cig char ba'o// cig char ba ni nyon mongs pa'i bag chags srab pa/ chos kyi bag chags 'thug pa'i sbyangs pa can gyi gang zag la zer ba yin te/ shin tu dka' ba yin gsung*/ bla ma'i zhal nas nga ni rim gyis par 'dod pa yin gsung*/ ngas bla ma mi la'i drung du mi mang rab cig yong ba'i dus su/ rdzogs chen 'di ci tsug lags zhus pas/ bla ma mar pa'i zhal nas chos min pa skad zer te/ chos min pa mi 'dug /sa drug pa bdun pa yan chad kyi chos su 'dug gsung*/ de nas byis pa lo lnga tsam lon pa zhig la mdzub mo btsugs nas/ rdzogs chen pa rnams 'di dang 'dra ba yin te/ byis pa 'di na re nga la skyes bu lo nyi shu rtsa lnga lon pa'i nus pa yod zer ba dang 'dra ba yin/ rdzogs chen pa rnams kyang da lta sangs rgyas pa skad zer te/ don dang mi ldan gsung*/ 'khor ba las thar par 'dod na/ don dam pa byang chub kyi sems shig med na thar pa'i thabs med gsung*/ don dam pa byang chub kyi sems ni shin tu dka'/ rang cag la 'khris med na sla ba yin te/ dge bshes yon bdag gi zhal nas/ sangs rgyas dang snga 'dris gang na yod/ sangs rgyas lag pa'i lto rgyab dang 'dra ba zhig yin te gsung*/ 'o cag (35ba)bzhin du phar 'khris tshur 'khris pa la/ don dam byang chub sems ga na mchi/ 'khris de nyid 'khor ba yin pa'i gnad kas gsung*/ spyir chos gsha' mar byed pa la/ yin pa dang ma yin pa dang*/ legs pa dang nyes pa dag brtsis pas ga na mchi/ de kun gang la yang mi blta bar rang gi shes pa skad cig ma la blta ba lags/ 'jig rten pa dang 'dzol le ba zhig dgos pa yin/

'jig rten pa rnams 'phyas se ba zhig dgos pa yin/ de ltar legs tshul du gda'/ rang cag kyang de ltar bgyi 'tshal/ tshe 'di'i so nam zung bzhi ya brgyad byed kyang*/ mi byed dgu byed byas pas 'khor ba 'brel thag chod pa gar mchi/ dgongs mdzod dang*/ ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bya'o// zer ba ni so so'i skye bo la zer ba yin/ ma grol ba rnams grol bar bya'o// bya ba ni/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams la zer ba yin/ yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las bzla bar bya'o bya ba ni/ sa dang po nas bcu pa man chod la zer ba yin/ khas ni de tsam blangs te gsung ngo*// rje sgam po pas gsungs pa'o// rdzogs so// //bla ma rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs kyis/ byang chub kyi sems dang*/ sgyu ma lta bu dang*/ stong pa gsum la brten nas rtogs pa rgyud la 'khrungs/ sngags kyi lugs kyis lus lha/ ngag bzlas pa/ yid chos nyid gsum la brten nas rtogs pa rgyud la 'khrungs/ ma rtogs na 'tshang mi rgya/ yu bu'i lugs kyis/ chos kyi 'khyer lugs 'dis/ yar la 'gro ba las mar la mi 'gro ba yin/ dbang po rab 'tshang rgya ba yin/ 'bring 'phags pa'i gnas lngar skye ba yin/ tha ma yang lhar skye gsung*/ bden (36na)pa gnyis kyi dbang du byas na dran rig sna tshogs kun rdzob yin/ sems kyi ngo bo don dam yin/ da lta yod pa'i ngo bo'i nyams 'di sangs rgyas nas kyang yod pa yin/ shes pa sna tshogs su shar yang longs spyad du btub pa/ chab rom la chu 'byung ba bzhin no// stong pa snying rje dbyer mi byed pa ni 'od las 'od chad pa bzhin du 'dod/ rtog pa thams cad 'od las 'od chad pa bzhin du 'dod/ gnyid che yang mi sto/ ngo bo skye 'jig dang bral bar rtogs nas mi 'jig pas chog pa yin/ chos thams cad hril gyis dril na rtog pa dang*/ rtog med gnyis su 'dus/

rtog pa rang yang chos kyi sku yin/ gcig tu rtogs pas thams cad tshur thob nas 'ong ba yin/ khyed cag la bshad rgyu yang med de/ 'on kyang don dam de bla ma'i gsung gis kyang thog tu mi phebs/ rtog ge'i yul las 'das pa yin/ rtog ge bas mthong na kun rdzob kyis don dam mthong bas/ don dam yang 'jig par 'gyur/ don dam gyis mthong na rtog pa dang bcas pa 'di yin bya ba gcig pus rang gi sems nyid 'od gsal ba de nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par bsgoms na yang de ltar skye zhing 'dug /'phags pa'i gnas gzhan du bsgoms na'ang 'ong zhing 'dug /'dug sa yang 'di rang du bsgoms na yang 'ong zhing 'dug /'od gsal de su yi yin na rang gi yin/ rtogs pa dang ma rtogs pas thams cad la khyab/ rang gis rang rig /rang gsal gsal la ma 'gags/ steng 'og med par 'od gsal/ mtha' dbus med par 'od gsal/ rnam rtog yod med med par 'od gsal du 'dug la/ de'i ngang la gnas pa de 'jig rten las 'das pa bya ba yin/ de la bogs 'don (36ba)rgyu med/ de las rtogs pa bogs 'don na/ 'don pa rang skyon can yin/ de las bogs sam rtags sam de las 'phul sa 'byung na/ de rang skyon can yin gsung ngo*// ngo bo skyes nas yun ring bsgoms pa'i rgad po kun la bogs sam/ dri rgyu 'ong zhing 'dug gam mi 'dug zhus pas/ dri rgyu yang med/ bogs 'don rgyu yang med/ nga'i drung du 'ongs kyin bla'o 'dra de btang 'gro yin 'dug gsungs/ ngo bo gcig chod du song ba la yang rmi lam du ngo bo mi zin par 'dug /bar do zin nam mi zin zhus pas/ bla ma kun na re rmi lam du zin dgos gsung ste/ ngas bltas pas rmi lam du ma zin yang*/ bar dor zin 'ong*/ da lta bsgom pa bas rmi lam mi gsal du 'gro bas mi zin/ bar dor da lta bas kyang gsal du 'gro bas zin 'ong gsung*/ da lta ngo bo ldang 'jug pa zhig shi na/ bar dor ldang 'jug 'ong ngam/

cig chod la 'gro zhus pas/ da lta ngo bo rgyun chad med par yod na bar dor yang cig chod la 'gro /ldang 'jug pa de bar dor yang ldang 'jug 'ong ste/ der bsgoms pas 'di bas bogs che bas cig chod la 'gro gsung*/ don dam byang chub sems rgyun du rtogs nas gnas pas/ kun rdzob byang sems bsgom dgos sam mi dgos zhus pas/ goms pa las byung ba dang*/ bsgoms pa las byung ba dang*/ rtogs pa las byung ba gsum yin/ goms pa las byung ba ni tshe snga ma phan chad bsgoms pas/ 'di rang la bsgom mi dgos par byang chub kyi sems 'ong ba yin/ bsgoms pa las byung ba ni tshe 'di la bsgom la song ba yin/ rtogs pa las byung ba ni/ don rtogs pas ma rtogs pa'i sems can la shugs kyis byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems 'byung ba yin/ (37na)logs su kun rdzob byang chub sems dang*/ don dam gnyis bsgom mi dgos/ don dam rtogs na byams snying rje gzhan don du 'byung ba rgyu 'bras yin/ nyon mongs pa shugs kyis ldog pa yin/ ngo bo rtogs zer yang mi dge ba la 'jug /byams snying rje byang chub sems chung bar 'dug na/ ngo bo ma skyes pa yin/ bla ma rje btsun gsung ba de yin gsung ngo*// rje btsun snyung ba'i dus su thugs mi bde ba 'ong yin gda' 'am/ mi gda' zhus pas/ na dus su yang sems mi bde ba dang*/ gnod pa cang mi yong bar 'dug /gang na sar 'od gsal du bsgoms pas/ 'od gsal du phri le 'ong zhing mi gnod par 'dug /'dres na ba'i mi la sngags btab pa bas/ gang na sar dmigs pa gtad nas 'od gsal bsgoms na phan pa 'dug gsung*/ ngo bo dang mnyam bzhag 'dres pa bya ba ci la zer ba lags zhus pas/ bsgom pa zhes pa nang spyod lam rnam bzhi gang byed kyang*/ 'od gsal dang ma bral bar dus rtag tu ngo bor song na 'dres pa yin gsung*/ res 'ga' dran pa shor nas rnam rtog thog tu 'gro /dran pa rnyed nas ngo bor 'ong ba de ma 'dres pa yin nam zhus pas/

de ma 'dres pa yin gsung*/ 'o na ngo bo de cha gcig ma rtogs pa yin nam/ bsgom yun thung nas ma goms pa yin zhus pas/ de ngo bo mtha' dag ma rtogs pa yin/ ma goms pa yang yin te/ don la bsgom yun thung pa yin gsung*/ 'o na rnam smin gyi lus po 'di yod kyi bar du/ mnyam bzhag dang rjes thob med par mi 'gro ba cang lags sam zhus pas/ de min/ rnam smin gyi lus yod kyang*/ yun ring du bsgoms pas mnyam bzhag dang rjes (37ba)thob med par 'phral la tshe 'di rang la 'gro ba yin gsung*/ 'o na dran pa shor ma thag tu bag chags rang ga mar 'gro ba 'di cis lan zhus pas/ 'di gzung 'dzin ma dag pas lan/ yun ring du bsgoms pas gzung 'dzin dag nas dran pas bzung rgyu med par mnyam rjes med par 'gro gsung*/ 'o na ngo bo skyes nas mnyam rjes ma 'dres par shi na/ bar dor skye ba 'dag gam mi 'dag zhus pas/ de 'dag pa yin the tshom med pa yin gsung*/ 'o na da lta dran pas ma zin pa'i rnam rtog de sgrib par mi 'gyur ram zhus pas/ de sgrib par mi 'gro /rnam rtog de rnams kyis las gsog par mi nus te/ nam mkha' la sa bon btab pa dang 'dra/ 'bras bu 'byin pa'i gnas med/ thams cad skye med du rtogs pa'i gnad kas gsung*/ 'o na gnyid mthug po'am rmi lam gyi dus su ngo bo ma zin par 'dug na/ bar dor ngo bo zin nam mi zin zhus pas/ de gnyid dang rmi lam gyi dus su ngo bo ma zin kyang*/ bar dor zin pa yin/ gnyid dang rmi lam dus su da lta bas mi gsal du 'gro ba yin/ bar dor da lta bas gsal du 'gro ba yin/ da lta bas bzung sla ba yin gsung*/ 'o na dran pas ma zin na ngo bo mi 'ong bar rnam rtog rang ga ma de dran pas zin pa dang*/ sngar gyi rnam rtog de tsho 'dag gam mi 'dag /dran pas shi ma shi med par 'dzin dgos sam mi dgos zhus pas/ dran pas mi zin pa'i rnam rtog rang ga ma rnams dran pas zin ma thag tu sangs la 'dag

/dran pas shi ma shi med par bzung mi dgos/ 'o na yang dran pas ma yengs par byas na/ mnyam rjes 'dres skyen pa la phan/ dran pas ma zin kyang rnam rtog gis gnod pa dang*/ sgrib pa dang bar du gcod pa gtan med (38na)gsung*/ 'o na dran pas bzung zhing ma yengs par bya ba las gzhan nyams su blang rgyu med dam zhus pas/ dran pas bskul ba tsam las gzhan nyams su blang rgyu ci yang med pa yin gsung*/ ngo bo 'ba' zhig bsgom pa las bskyed rim dang bzlas pa dgos sam mi dgos zhus pas/ sngags bag re bzlas na/ ngag byin gyis rlob pa 'byung bas/ sngags bzlas/ lha bsgom mi dgos/ 'od gsal gyi ngang nas bzlos pa yin gsung ngo*// zhus lan// //yang bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos chos su 'gro ba/ chos lam du 'gro ba/ lam 'khrul pa sel ba/ 'khrul pa ye shes su 'char ba'o// chos ni/ las 'bras la yid ches nas nyes pa phra ba la 'dzem pa'o// chos su 'gro ba ni/ dge ba ci byed tshe 'dis ma gos pa'o// chos lam du 'gro ba ni/ byams pa snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyis 'phangs nas/ dge ba ci dang ci byed pa thams cad gzhan don du bsngo ba'o// lam 'khrul pa sel ba ni/ byang chub kyi sems gnyis bsgoms pas chos thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur rtogs pa'o// 'khrul pa ye shes su 'char ba ni/ gzhan don de nyid kyang 'khrul pa yin te/ ngar 'dzin rtog pa dang bral ba'i ngo bo de rtogs na 'khrul pa ye shes su 'char ro// 'khrul pa sel mkhan logs na med/ ngo bo nyid yin pas na/ lam gyi 'khrul pa sel ba'o// rdzogs so// //bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ lto phar tshur/ gos phar tshur la brten la

blo ma log na chos mi 'ong gsung*/ sgrub dang*/ brtson 'grus 'bar ba'i stobs le lo can gyis mi 'ong*/ kyis bsgrub na/ dang por nang gi slob dpon/ sems (38ba)nyid slob dpon du 'char/ de nas po bla mas ma zin na/ ti gang bltas slob dpon du 'char/ de nas snang grags kyi chos thams cad slob dpon du shar/ phyi'i bla ma/ chos thams cad gnyis med du 'char/ de tsam na spong len med pa'i sgom chen bya ba'am/ mi bsgom pa'i sgom chen bya ba yin/ bsam gtan med cing rtogs pas 'tshang rgya phyag rgya chen po nas/ ba'o// zer ba de yong ba yin/ chos thams cad gcig tu 'char ba yin/ bcos ma thams cad dang bral dus gsum spros bral du/ ba/ ma bcos pa shugs 'byung rgyun chad med pa/ spros pa mtha' dag dang bral ba/ ngos bzung mtha' dag dang bral ba/ rig pa 'di nyid/ 'dzin pa mtha' dag gzung 'dzin gnyis med/ dang bral ba/ ci'i ngo bor yang ma grub pa/ bsgom pa'i blo dang bral ba/ 'bad rtsol med pa/ mi bsgom dus gsum spros bral/ pa yang ma yin pas dus thams cad du ma bral ba/ ye gdod ma nas dang po nas rtogs su dka' ba la snyam pa/ dag pa/ 'du 'bral med pa dang po rang nas sangs rgyas sla sla 'dra bas/ zin par 'dug snyam pa/ rtogs pa'i ye shes de la 'gyur ba med pa/ rgyun chad pa med pa/ dang po nas rgyun chad ma myong bas/ dus thams cad pa/ gsal la gsal stong zung 'jug ngos bzung med pa/ bde la zag pa med pa/ de zag med sems kyi stong pa nyid/ nyam nga thams cad dang bral ba/ skye med gzhi bral chen po'i nang nas 'char ro// bla ma rtogs bla ma la byin rlabs zhus na phugs 'khrul pa mi 'ong bas/ ldan zhig gis/ slob ma mtshan ldan zhig la byin rlabs gsha' ma zhig zhus nas/ yon tan thams cad dus cig tu spungs pa bzhin 'byung ba chos nyid yin/ dus gsum gyi bla ma thams cad kyi byin rlabs 'jug /(39na)bka' sde snod thams cad kyi byin rlabs 'jug

/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin rlabs 'jug /mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad kyang de la 'du ba yin/ spyir theg pa chen po'i chos theg pa chen po'i chos thams cad yang dag pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen la rag lus pas gsung*/ thams cad byin rlabs las 'byung*/ de'i nang nas gsang sngags kyi chos thams cad byin rlabs las 'byung*/ khyad par du nā ro'i chos bka' brgyud pa byin rlabs las 'byung ba yin/ nga'i brgyud pa 'di grub pa thob pa rgyun ma chad pa byin rlabs kyi bka' babs pa/ bka' brgyud kyi dar chags pas/ gong ma gong mas/ 'og ma 'og ma smin pa dang grol bar mdzad pa/ 'og ma 'og mas/ gong ma gong ma la gtsug gi nor bu'am/ mig gi 'bras bu bzhin du gces par 'dzin pa shi 'jus byas pa yin/ bka' brgyud kyi gdams ngag zab mo 'di rnams ni gsang sngags kyi snying phyung ba'am/ rgyud sde bzhi yi bcud nying khu lta bu yin/ chos 'di rnams mkha' 'gro'i lag na yod pa yin pas/ shin tu zab pa'am gnyan par 'dug /bla ma rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ rang gi slob dpon dang grogs po la'ang ma sbyin zhig gsung*/ min na rang gar 'gro'i phyir 'brang ba/ rang la mi bdog kyang ka ca yo phul nas sgrub pa 'ba' zhig byed pa la sbyin gsung*/ yang na rnal 'byor pa'i lus dang*/ gsang sngags zab mo'i gdams ngag dang*/ nyams su myong ba'i gdams pa gsum sba na legs gsung*/ sbed pa yang khong rang las mi 'byung gsung*/ rin po che'i zhal nas ngas bla ma mi la'i bka' bcag gsung*/ de ga tsug lags zhus pas/ ngas chos thams cad (39ba)mi la bshad pas gsung*/ yang dus gcig tsa na/ ngas bla ma'i bka' bzhin bsgrub gsung*/ de ga tsug lags zhus pas/ ngas mi tshe zang mar sgrub pa byas pas gsung ngo*// rje sgam po pa'i gsung sgros// //rin po che'i zhal nas/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bka' la brten pa'i bstan bcos dang*/

slob dpon mkhas pa rnams kyis lung bkrol ba'i bstan bcos dang*/ lung bsdu ba'i bstan bcos la sogs pa brtsams pa dang*/ grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa la nang nas shar bas/ gang la yang ma brten par mdzad pa'i bstan bcos dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' dngos dang*/ bla ma rnams kyi gsung sgros dang*/ rang gi rgyud la skyes pa'i nyams rnams mthun pa'i yin/ ma mthun na rang gis chos ma shes pa yin gsung*/ spyir chos gsha' mar byed na rtsis su che ba yin/ gsha' mar mi nus na gzhi gcig bzung nas byed pa yin/ gsha' mar byed na ri bong gi rnam thar byed pa yin/ yul gcig tu mi bsdad/ yon bdag gcig la mi bya/ grogs po gcig dang mi 'grogs/ grogs po dang ha cang yang mdza' ches pa nyon mongs pa'i rtsa ba yin/ bla ma dang ha cang yang nye ba min/ ring ba min gsung*/ me dang 'dra ba yin/ nye na 'tshig /ring na mi dros/ yang na mkhas pas 'thab pa'am/ yang na legs par 'bros pas yong ba yin te/ mkhas pa 'thab pa bya ba/ mi mkho ba de nyid 'dod thog tu byed pa yin te/ dka' ba yin/ mi mkhas pa 'bros pa bya ba/ nyon mongs pa la sogs pas mi gos par/ de las 'bros pa yin/ 'khor ba las thar par 'dod na 'jig rten pa dang gnyis 'dzol le ba zhig dgos pa yin/ tshe 'di'i so nams zung bzhi (40na)ya brgyad byed cing*/ mi byed dgu byed byed pas 'khor ba dang 'brel thag chod pa ga na mchi/ dgongs mdzod dang*/ thams cad ltogs kyis dogs te/ ltogs na ngas bslus pa yin no gsung*/ rin po che'i zhal nas/ phyag rgya chen po lam lnga dang sbyar nas stan thog gcig tu bsgom na sbyor ba byang chub kyi sems kyis 'phangs nas/ dngos gzhi rmi lam sgyu ma bzhin du bsgom pa tshogs lam yin/ stong pa nyid du mos pa'i tshul du bsgom pa sbyor lam yin/ phyag rgya chen po rgyud la skyes pa mthong lam/ de nyid goms par byed pa sgom lam yin/ de ltar yang*/

ma mthong mthong phyir mthong ba'i lam// mthong ba goms phyir sgom pa'i lam// zhes gsungs/ de nyid mngon du gyur tsa na/ re dogs gza' gtad gzung 'dzin mtha' dag dang bral ba de mthar phyin pa'i lam mo// 'o na mthong lam gyi gnas skabs su yang*/ sprul pa'i sku brgya la chos nyan pa la sogs pa la/ re re la yon tan dpag tu med pa bshad pa yod snyam na/ rnam pa don dam la bshad pa dang*/ rnam pa kun rdzob la bshad pa gnyis yin/ dang po rtags de lta bu med kyang 'gal ba med/ rtags de rnams kun rdzob la bshad pa la 'ong ba yin/ sangs rgyas skad pa mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa/ rang rgyud par grub pa med/ sems nyid ngo bo cir yang ma grub pa 'di rang sangs rgyas yin gsung*/ de yang 'od srung kyis zhus pa las/ sems ni 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis kyang ma gzigs mi gzigs/ gzigs par mdo dgongs 'dus las sems de nyid sangs rgyas kyis kyang ma gzigs mi gzigs gzigs par mi 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs/ mi 'gyur zhes bshad do// sems (40ba)kyi gnas lugs de lta bu zhig rtogs na srung ba rnams kyi nang na yang mchog yin te/ stong pa nyid ni bsgom pa ni// 'chi bdag gis ni mi mthong zhing*// rang bzhin dag pa yongs su mthong*// zhes gsungs so// mchod pa rnams kyi nang na yang mchog yin te/ mchod bya mchod byed mchod pa rnams// de tshe rnal 'byor pas ma mthong*// de nyid mchod pa'i mchog yin pas// mkhas pas byang chub sems bsgom bya// zhes gsungs/ nyams grib la sogs pa bshags pa'i mchog tu gyur pa yin te/ bshags bya bshags byed bshags pa rnams// gang tshe rnal 'byor pas ma mthong*// rang bzhin dag par yongs su mthong*// de ni bshags pa'i mchog yin no// zhes gsungs so// phyag rgya chen po'i don de bdud bzhi dang bral ba yang yin te/ sems 'di la skye shi med pas 'chi bdag gi bdud dang bral/

nyon mongs pa med pas nyon mongs bdud dang bral/ gzugs su grub pa med pas phung po'i bdud dang bral/ zhen pa med pas lha'i bu'i bdud dang bral ba'o// phyag rgya chen po'i gnas lugs de rtogs na/ thabs rnams kyi nang nas kyang mchog yin te/ 'od gsal ba la rgyun chad med// bar do'i grong khyer des mi mthong*// zhes pa dang*/ de nyid kyis 'pho ba yang de rang yin gsung*// //yang rin po che'i zhal nas/ sgom chen pa la gdeng bzhi dgos pa yin/ lta ba'i gdeng bya ba chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs kyi don nang du shar bas/ blo'i yul du ci snang ba thams cad de'i ngang du shes pa zhig dgos/ gsang sngags kyi nus pa'i gdeng bya ba/ rang gi yi dam lha'i bsnyen pa byas pas yi dwags kyi bar chad la sogs pa ci byung yang phaṭa byas pas chog snyam pa zhig (41na)dgos/ bla ma'i man ngag gi gdeng bya ba zhi rgyas dbang drag la sogs pa gang dang gang byed pa shes pa zhig dgos gsung ngo*// //na mo gu ru/ tshe 'di la blo log pa'i mi zhig gis dben pa'i gnas su phyin nas bla ma'i man ngag chun pa gsum yin te/ rtsa chun pas 'byung ba ro snyoms pa 'byung*/ rlung chun pas shing rtse la bsgom nus pa 'byung*/ sems chun pas nyon mongs pas ma gos shing nyams su myong ba nang nas 'char ba 'byung ngo*// rig pa ngo shes pa dang*/ rtogs pa nyams su myong ba gnyis gal che gsung*/ ngo shes pa rig pa ngos bzung med pa/ spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba/ rgyun chad pa med par rtogs pa de yin/ ma rig pa yang rig par ngo shes shing the tshom med par rtogs pa de yin gsung ngo*// ma rig pa'i grogs dug lnga yin te/ de ye shes lngar 'char ba de sus kyang mi khegs pa yin te/ sems de 'dra 'char ba ni don grub pa yin no// de lta bu rgyud la 'char ba las gcig tu spungs pa mi 'ong gsung ngo*// //bla ma chen po nā ro pas/ gsang sngags rgyal po yi ge bdun// 'bum phrag gcig tu bzlas pa yin// sa rnams g.yos shing lung bstan thob// shar phyogs dngos su tai lo pa'i// zhal sngar gdams ngag mnos pa ni// dngos po'i gnas lugs lam dang ni// 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa'o// dngos po'i gnas lugs gnyis yin te// lus dang sems su shes par bya/

de la lus dngos po'i gnas lugs rtsa 'khor lo'i bdag nyid du gnas pa dang*/ sems dngos po'i gnas lugs rig pa dang stong pa dbyer med du gnas pa'o// lam la gnyis te/ ma smin pa smin par byed pa dbang gi lam dang*/ smin pa grol bar (41ba)byed pa thabs bskyed rdzogs gnyis so// dbang la bzhi ste/ bum pa'i dbang dang*/ gsang ba'i dbang dang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang dang*/ tshig dbang rin po che dang bzhi'o// bskyed pa'i rim pa la yang ku su lu pa'i lugs kyis/ skad cig cig gis dran rdzogs so// de yang rnam pa lha/ rang bzhin stong pa/ ngo bo gsal stong dbyer med do// rdzogs rim la mtshan bcas dang*/ mtshan med gang bsgom yang*/ lus kyi gnad dang*/ rtsa'i gnad dang*/ yul gyi gnad dang*/ dus kyi gnad dang bzhi las/ ye shes 'char bar bzhed do// lus kyi gnad la gnyis te/ lus gnad dngos dang*/ lus de la brten pa'i rlung gis sbyor ba'o// lus gnad dngos la bdun te/ rkang pa re'u mig bzhin snol ba dang*// sgal pa chu shing bzhin du bsrang ba dang*// mnyam bzhag rgya yi btsir ba dang*// lcags kyu bzhin du dgug pa dang*// 'phel ka bzhin du bskyed pa dang*// li khri bzhin du bsgrim pa dang*// mig gi sna rtser dbab pa'o// de la dgos pa bdun yod de/ re'u mig ltar bsnol bas drod skye/ chu shing ltar bsrangs pas rlung rang gnas tshud/ mnyam bzhag rgya yis bde ba bskyed/ lcags kyu ltar bkug pas rtog pa 'gag /'phel ka bskyed pas rlung gnad chud/ li khri bzhin du bsgrims pas drod skye myur/ mig sna rtser phab pas sems gsal lo// //na mo gu ru/ rin po che'i zhal nas/ 'khor bar 'khyams pa cis lan/ ma rig pas lan/ ma rig pa ci tsug tu 'dug /ma rig pa stong pa nyid du 'dug /ma rig pa lung ma bstan du 'dug pa la/ rkyen dge ba dang phrad na dge ba'i grogs byed/ mi dge ba dang phrad na mi dge bar 'gyur ba la/

(42na)'du byed byung bas ma rig pa de 'du byed kyi ngo bor shar bas/ 'du byed de dge mi dge gnyis la g.yo// der 'du shes byung bas/ dge mi dge gnyis su bzung bas nyon mongs pa la 'jug /der rnam par shes pa byung bas/ rnam par shes pa la bag chags kyi sa bon btab pas 'khor bar 'khor/ 'o na 'khor ba las thar pa'i thabs gang yin na/ bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag la brten nas ma rig pa rig par ngo sprad pas/ rnam par shes pa 'od gsal du shar bas/ bag chags kyi sa bon gdab pa'i sa med/ 'du byed kyang 'od gsal du shar bas rgyu 'bras las grol ba'o// rgyu'i dus na 'bras bur rtogs pas/ rgyu dang 'bras bu dus mtshungs bya ba yin gsung*// //na mo gu ru/ rin po che'i zhal nas/ spyir yang kun la zas kyi rnal 'byor med thabs med de/ des na sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa la zas kyi rnal 'byor dang*/ spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor yang shes par bya/ bza' ba dang bca' ba thams cad la oṃ āḥhūṃ gis byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang yi dam gyi lhar bsams nas mchod pa byed pa ni zas kyi rnal 'byor ro// spyod lam thams cad chos nyid kyi ngang du byed pa ni spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ro// sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa des ni/ zas 'di mi bza' bya ba med/ spyod pa 'di mi bya ba med/ gos la 'di mi gon bya ba med/ kun la nyam nga med pas dpa' bo seng ge lta bur spyod/ sngags kyi lam du zhugs nas dam tshig la gnas dgos te/ de la bsrung ba'i dam tshig dang*/ spyad pa'i dam tshig gnyis las spyad pa'i dam tshig ni lus lha'i nga rgyal dang mi 'bral ba de ni sku'i dam tshig /ngag bzlas pa dang mi (42ba)'bral ba ni gsung gi dam tshig /yid skye med dang mi 'bral ba ni thugs kyi dam tshig ste/ de ni spyad pa'i dam tshig go /bsrung ba'i dam tshig ni/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi dang*/ mi dge ba bcu spong ba yin gsung*/ lus kyi gsum ni sku'i 'o// ngag gi bzhi ni gsung gi'o// yid kyi gsum ni thugs kyi dam tshig go

/rig pa 'dzin pa'i dus gcig na 'di skad kyang gsung*/ rang lha yin gzhan yang lha yin pas/ lhas lha gsod pa'am/ brdeg pa'am khro ba'am/ brdzun zer ba ga na mchis/ de ltar yang bsam 'tshal gsung*/ spyir sngags nas ni gsang bar bshad pa yin la/ ma gsang na dngos grub kyi sgo 'chor ba yin gsung*// //na mo gu ru/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ bla ma mtshan ldan zhig dang*/ slob ma tshad ldan phrad nas/ blo sna khrid na lam gcod pa la tshegs med/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la rag las pas/ de min na lam la rnyed pa'i dus mi 'ong gsung*/ bla ma ni shes rab kyi mig can dang*/ chos kyi mig can gnyis yin te/ shes rab kyi mig shes bya gtan la 'bebs pas/ can ni chos spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid la mkhas pas/ chos kyi don phyin ci ma log pa/ ma 'dres par don spyi ma nor ba/ ston pa'o// chos kyi mig can ni chos kyi don ma nor bar lhag gis rtogs pa/ don rang gi ngo bo nyams su myong ba/ shes pa rnal mar nang nas shar ba/

de gshis la ma shor bar/ shar nas kyang rang gi khyab 'brel slob ma grol bar nus pa'o/ gzhan la skrun par nus pa'o// yang na bla ma'i mtshan nyid ni bzhi ste/ dkon mchog gsum la thun mong ma yin pa yod pa'o/ dad pa'i bdag thob pa/ sems can la snying rje ba'i bdag thob pa/ snying rjes sems can thams cad blo phugs su 'jug pa/ (43na)zab mo'i chos la nges pa'i bdag thob pa/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs rtogs shing nges shes skyes pa'o/ zang rang 'khris med/ zing med par 'gro gzhan phan/ la chos ston chos de dang ldan na gzhan 'dren par nus pa yin gsung ngo*/ nus pa'o// khong ston pa rnams ni sgro 'dogs phyi nas bcad nas chos nyid rtogs par 'dod pa'o// chos mang po thos par 'dod/ mang po ma thos pa la bsam pa med/ ma bsgoms bla ma'i zhal nas 'dzin pa'i sems gtan la phab na/ bzung ba'i sgrog rang rdal du 'gro la de tsug byung*/ nga'i 'di na yang de tsug byung bar/ slob dpon shes rab bzang po'i zhal nas/ gzung ba gtan la phebs na/ 'dzin pa sgrog rang grol la 'gro gsung*/ pa la bsgom pa med zer/ ston pa rnams kyi lugs yin te/ rnam rtog ma zad na/ tha snyad kyi tshig la zad pa med/ tshig ma grub bzhin du btags pa yin no// sgrub pa po rnams ni sgro 'dogs nang du bcad nas chos nyid rtogs par 'dod/ gcig shes kun la mkhas pa bya ba yin te/ bla ma mi la'i zhal nas/ sgrub brgyud kyi gdams ngag la brten nas thams cad rdos thag chod par 'dug/ bslabs pa'i chos thams cad ni brjed/ ma bslabs pa'i chos thams cad ni 'char zhing 'dug /ngas 'bum tshar gcig tsam gyi chos bshad kyang zad pa med/ bla ma mar rngog gnyis deng sang yod na phar la chos 'chad pa yin pa la gsung*/ ma bslabs par yang shes par 'gyur// shes pa don dang ldan par 'gyur gsung*/ dgon pa pa'i zhal nas/ glu chung so'i bar nas len// kha 'ug po zhig la ci cha yod// gdams ngag nyams myong steng nas bshad// nyams myong med la ci cha yod// gsungs skad/

de dang (43ba)'dra ste/ nga bsgom pa la cha yod pa yin/ bka' blo byas 'ba' zhig yin/ gdams pa'i dge bshes rnams dang*/ mtshan nyid pa'i ston pa rnams dang*/ sngags pa la sogs khyed cag ci bsgom nga la cha yod/ nga ci bsgom khyed blo dang bral ba'i nyams myong*/ cag la cha med/ po to ba'i zhal nas/ khyed cag chos shes par 'dod na sgoms dang gsung ngo*// sgre pa'i zhal nas/ khyod lo gsum nyan pa bas/ lo gcig bsgoms na ting nge 'dzin dang a cang yang ches te/ so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis kyang de che 'ong gsung ngo*// de la nyan nas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen ri bo lta bu de la brten nas don 'grub gsung*/ rang cag gis kyang snga ma yang*/ 'di ma spyad bya ba med de/ dngos po dang mtshan mar spyad bzung bas// 'khor ba las 'phag ma nus/ mkhas pa paṇ+ḍi ta dang*/ gzhan gyi mkhan po dang*/ slob dpon dang*/ stong 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po la sogs pa 'di ma byas bya ba med de/ srid pa'i rtse mo man chad las/ thar pa'i rgyur 'gro ma myong*/ mkhas par gyur pa sde snod gsum kha ton du shes pa dang*/ rtogs pa rgyud la ma khel/ gnas pa'i nyams kyis srid pa'i rtse mo man chad kyi nyams yin/ lam yin/ btsun po sogs ma bcag mi 'chor ba dang*/ sgom nyin mtshan ngo mi shes pa la sogs pa yod kyang*/ rang sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa chos skur rtogs na 'bras bu yin gsung*/ gi sems ma rtogs na 'tshang mi rgya/ nga ni sgom bzang ba bas kyang sems rtogs pa la rtsis che gsung*/ sgom chen pa sgom bzhag nas gnas gzhi'i tshis byed pa dang*/ phan sems che che ltar gzhan la chos 'chad pa dang*/ srung skyob la sogs pa byed pa dang*/ chos dngos bzhag nas gzugs brnyan la spyod pa yin/ sgom chen pa la gnas (44na)brtan dang*/ gtso bo dang*/ gros dang*/ 'dun ma la sogs pa gcig kyang ma bcol/ 'o na byas pa la sgom pa bcol ba yin/ da ni rang cag sha ba smas ma bzhin du thams cad la 'bros dgos pa yin/

cis kyang byar med kyi blo zhig skye dgos/ gnod pa skyel ba dang a cang yang ches te/ phan 'dogs pa la yang 'bros dgos pa yin/ ma bros na ngo bsrung dgos/ ngos bsrungs ngan ngon brtan dgos pa yin no// byas na dge sbyong mi 'ong gsung*/ sgrub pa byed pa'i gang zag la/ mtha' chod pa dang*/ so thub pa bya ba gnyis yin/ mtha' chod pa bya ba ni/ chos spyi'i go yul dang*/ rnam gzhag che ba/ lta ba'i don la mkhas pa/ chos thams cad kyi yin lugs dang 'gros shes pa'o// tshugs thub pa ni ci la yang mi lta bar thams cad gzhag nas sgrub brgyud kyi gdams ngag zab mo 'di rnams snying phugs su bcug nas/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sgrub pa byed pa yin/ kha phyi ru mi blta nang du bltas nas/ rang gi 'khris gang na 'dug rtsad gcod pa yin/ 'jig rten pa thams cad dang phar re tshur re la blo 'dres 'ong*/ mi mthun pa zhig dgos pa yin/ 'jig rten pa ni shes pa phyin ci log pa yin/ rang cag de las bzlog par 'dod pa yin/ rgya gar na pu ru ṣa bya ba stobs dang ldan pa'i tha tshig /de bzhin du gzhon nu stobs dang ldan pa'i dus sgrub dgos pa yin/ ma bsgrubs par 'tshang rgya ba mi mchi/ bla ma mi la'i zhal nas/ sgrub pa ma byas par rnal 'byor pa yin rnal 'byor pa chos nyid ma mthong ba la zer ba yin/ zer ba 'dug na/ de ci las byung ba yin nam gsung*/ yang bla ma'i zhal nas/ brag phug dgon par yun bsrings nas/ bltas (44ba)ni rang gi sems la bltas/ slob ma rnams kyang sems la ltos gsung*/ dgon pa ba'i zhal nas/ khyed nga la sgom zhu na/ sngar phan bslabs pa'i chos tsho dung phyis pa bzhin thong*/ de nas nga la thar pa'i rgyur 'gro ba bya ba/ phyin ci log gi shes pa las log nas chos lam du 'gro ba zhig dgos pa yin/ bla ma'i man ngag la brten nas grub mtha' dang blo ma 'dres pa zhig dgos pa yin/ sgom bslab kyi gsungs nas/

slob dpon yon bdag la/ thig le zhig la sems gtad 'dzin du bcug pas sems ye ma zin/ dge bshes pa 'dra ba la nyan pas phan par byung*/ en re tsam nyan par zhu byas pas/ mi rgan nga la nyan na sgoms shig gsung*/ de nas zla ba dgu lon nas/ sgom byung nas bla ma la dris pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas mdung byi khung du 'dzul pa bya ba yin/ da gdod kyis mdung nam mkha' la bskor ba bya ba 'ong ba yin/ da ni thun re nyan kyang phan/ thun re bltas kyang phan/ nga'i chos rnams gzhan dang ma 'dres par sgoms shig gsung*/ de nas nyan snying yang ma 'dod/ blta snying yang ma 'dod pa/ sgom gcig pu la blo song nas bsgoms pas/ phyis ting nge 'dzin klong du gyur nas/ bla ma la dris pas/ de ni mdung nam mkha' la bskor ba bya ba yin gsung skad/ de nas slob dpon yon bdag gis/ dgon pa ba la/ slob dpon gyi chos tsho nga rang nyams su len/ dge bshes pa la gzhan nas bslabs nas bshad dam zhus pas/ dgon pa'i zhal nas/ lung pa zhig na mar la/ chu gtsang ma gcig dang*/ mi gtsang ba gcig gnyis yod na 'dres nas 'gro ba yin/ nyan yang ma nyan/ bshad kyang ma bshad/ sgom gcig pu gyis shig gsungs nas sgrub pa 'ba' zhig mdzad pas/ phyis ni yon tan mang po mnga' ba'i skyes bu de la yod (45na)tshul du 'dug gsung ngo*// slob ma'i blo tshod bla ma mkhas pas 'khrid kyin pa zhig dgos pa yin/ slob mas kyang ci dran dran dris/ bla mas kyang ci dran dran bshad pas/ bag med pa'i spyod pa bya ba yin/ chos lam du mi 'gro gsung ngo*// //bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ spyir gang zag dbang po rab 'bring tha ma gsum du phye ba yin te/ gang zag dbang po rab de dka' ba yin/ mi 'ong ba yin gsung*/ de ji ltar dka' zhus pas/ dbang po rab cig gis chos nyid skye ba med pa'i don lhangs kyis rtogs pa'i dus su/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten sa rdo dang ri brag /ngam grog dang g.yang sa/

gcong rong dang*/ bya skyibs dang*/ rtsig pa dang re lde la sogs pa thams cad chos kyi skur 'khyer shes pa/ nang bcud kyi sems can skyes pa dang bud med/ rta dang glang po la sogs pa thams cad mi rtag par shes/ rmi lam sgyu ma tsam du shes/ snang ba 'di thams cad ban bun du song*/ de tsa na don dam par chos thams cad skye ba med pa las 'os mi 'dug snyam par shes pa'i dus su/ thams cad la bzang ngan med/ che chung med/ yin min med/ gser dang bong ba/ dgra dang bur mnyam pa/ 'khor ba 'di'i zhen pa log /chos thams cad spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba zhig la/ gang zag dbang po rab zer ba yin te/ dka' ba yin/ mi 'ong ba yin gsung*/ de bas dbang po 'bring yang dka' ba yin gsung*/ de ji ltar dka' zhus pa la/ gang zag dbang po 'bring zhig la bar do'i shes pa 'ong bas/ rmi lam bar do zin pa zhig sbyong dgos pa yin gsung*/ rmi lam bar do ngos zin pa la dgos pa ci yod zhus pas/ gnyid log pa dang shi ba 'dra ba yin/ rmi lam dang (45ba)bar do 'dra ba yin gsung*/ de ji ltar 'dra zhus pa la/ gnyid log pa'i dus su/ lus sha khrag gi brdos pa can 'di/ mal na ro dang 'dra bar yod pa la/ sems kyi rnam par rtog pa des gar yang rtol/ ci yang byed/ dpe de dang 'dra ba zhig bar do'i shes pa la yang 'byung bas/ rmi lam bar do ngos zin pa zhig sbyong dgos pa yin gsung*/ lar dbang po 'bring zhig gis/ chos nyid skye ba med pa'i don gcig pu bsgoms pas kyang mi 'ong*/ rgyu bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags nas/ 'bras bu ye shes kyi tshogs lam du 'khyer dgos pa yin gsung*/ rgyu bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa la/ ji ltar bgyi zhus pas/ dge ba che bas kyang mi lang*/ chung bas kyang mi lang bas/ che chung phyogs mtha' dag nas bar ma chad par gsog dgos pa yin gsung*/ 'bras bu ye shes kyi tshogs lam du 'khyer ba la ji ltar bgyi zhus pas/ bskyed pa'i rim pa dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa gnyis ka lam du 'khyer dgos gsung*/

cha gcig gis chog mod gnyis ka ci dgos byas pa la/ gang zag dbang po 'bring la res 'jog 'ong bas/ bskyed pa'i rim pa dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa zung 'jug tu bsgoms pas shi ba'i dus su bar do dang po'i byang chub ma thob kyang*/ bskyed pa'i rim pas sems ma zin yang rdzogs pa'i rim pas sems zin/ de gnyis kas ma zin kyang rgyu bsod nams kyi tshogs kyis ngan song du mi ltung*/ mi lus rin po che thob nas/ sngar bsgoms pa'i las 'phro sad nas/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku thob ste sangs rgyas bya ba yin gsung*/ de gnyis gang dka' gang sla zhus pa/ gang zag dbang po tha ma'i spyod pa sla bas/ de'i spyod pa nyams su blang gsung*/ de ji ltar blang (46na)zhus pas/ so so thar pa'i sdom pa ma nyams pa legs par bzung*/ mi dge ba bcu spang*/ dge ba bcu dang du blang*/ rgyu bsod nams kyi tshogs mtha' dag bsag /dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngo// theg pa chen po'i chos la smon lam gdab/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bskyed/ mthar sems can gyi don du bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par bya gsung*// //gu ru na mo// slob dpon rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos rang gsha' mar byed cing snying nas nyams su len na/ dang por tshe 'di la blo log dgos/ de'i go ba yang rnyed pa dang*/ bkur sti/ grags pa dang*/ snyan pa la sogs/ 'jig rten chos brgyad don du gnyer na blo ma log pa yin/ mkhas pas kyang mi phan/ btsun pa la sogs pa yon tan yod kyang mi phan pas/ 'chi ba dang mi rtag pa bsgoms nas/ tshe 'di las blo log pa zhig med pa'i thabs med pa yin gsung*/ shi ba'i rting la med nas mi 'gro /yang las kyis skye bar 'dug pas/ las 'bras la yid ches pa zhig cis kyang dgos/ mi dge ba chen po rnams dang a cang yang ches te/ phra mos kyang ngan song du skye bar gsungs pas/ sdig pa phra shing phra ba yang gnyen po'i sgo nas spang*/

so sor thar pa'i sdom pa bya ba yang de rang yin/ yang lha dang mi thob par 'dod pas/ dge ba spyad pas mtho ris thob ste/ bla na med pa'i byang chub ma thob na mir skyes kyang grogs med/ da lta dang khyad med/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las mi thar/ thams cad mi rtag pa yin pas bde ba med/ sdug bsngal gyi bden pa'i mtshan nyid mi rtag pa yin/ des na 'khor ba (46ba)la skyug log pa gal che/ de ltar 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las yid byung nas/ rang gcig pu zhi bde bsam pas gang zag gi bdag med rtogs na/ 'phags pa nyan thos kyi mya ngan las 'da' bar gsungs pa yin/ nyi tshe phyogs gcig gi stong pa de la yang sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las sems can gyi don las med pas/ lam theg pa chen po rang mchog yin/ 'jig rten pa'i dbang du byas na bod rigs ngan yin yang*/ gzhan don 'ba' zhig la blo sbyong bas bod theg pa chen po'i rigs can du byed/ theg pa chen po theg pa chen po zer yang*/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems gsum 'brel ba can du bsgoms nas/ ci byed sems can gyi don du byed na theg pa chen po yin gsung*/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems de gsang sngags nas tshad med pa bzhi la sogs pa gsungs/ jo bo rje'i zhal nas sngar gyi gsum po 'brel ba can du bsgoms na/ der 'dus gsung ba yin par 'dug /de yang sems can thams cad kyis 'o skol gyi pha dang mar ma byas pa med/ lan grangs dpag tu med pa byas pas gsung*/ 'khor ba la thog mtha' med pa'i gnad kas gsung*/ pha ma byas pa'i dus na thams cad drin can yin pas 'di rnams la bdag gis phan par bya/ bde bar bya snyam pa de byams pa/ rang sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa bzhin du sems can thams cad kyang sdug bsngal mi 'dod par mnyam/ rang bde ba 'dod pa bzhin du thams cad bde ba 'dod par mnyam pas/ sems can sdug bsngal dang bral bar bya'o snyam pa de snying rje/ rang gzhan du snang ba 'di sems yin pas snang ba tsam du mnyam pa yin/

don la bdag tu snang ba sems/ sems rang la bltas pas dngos po ngos bzung (47na)dang bral bas/ bdag gi don rang bya rgyu ma grub pa yin pas/ 'o na sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag gis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya'o snyam pa de byang chub kyi sems yin/ blo de la smon 'jug gnyis rim gyis sbyong ba yin gsung*/ mthar phyin pa'i dgongs pa'o/ /don dam byang chub kyi sems 'dis/ 'khor 'das thams cad la khyab pa yin/ 'di la chos nyid zer ba yin/ chos nyid kyi don go yang pha rol tu phyin pa kun nas phyi rol yul la rang bzhin gyis khyab pas/ rig pas gzhigs nas yul stong par mos pas bsgoms pas chos nyid mngon du gyur bar gsungs/ lam gcig yin/ dngos po la mngon par zhen pa dang 'bral ba la phan/ 'o skol lta ba dang sgom pa gnyis su byed/ lta ba yang chos nyid phyi nas mi 'tshol/ rang gi sems rig pa gsal la ngos bzung med pa 'di rang chos nyid yin/ 'dus ma byas zer ba yin/ rig mkhan rang la rang bzhin mi 'dug pas/ chos kyi dbyings zer ba yin/ de bzhin nyid/ yang dag pa'i mtha'/ don dam pa'i bden pa zer te/ lta ba yin/ sgom pa nyams su len pa des phyag rgya chen po'i dbang du byas nas/ dang por rtsol sgrub dang bral bas lus sems khong glod pa la sogs pa gsungs pas/ gnas dben par gdan bde ba'i steng du/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bzhugs

mig 'bras mi 'gul bar thad kar lta/ lugs dang gzigs lugs su bya/ byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ rang lus lhar gsal ba'i spyi bor bla ma bsgoms la/ rang gi ji ltar 'dug pa/ de rang gi thad kar ma bcos par rang lugs (47ba)su lhan gyi bzhag /bcos na rtog pa yin pas ma bcos pa gal che/ de'i ngang las rtog pa 'byung na mi spang*/ rang shar yin pas thad kar rang du ma bcos par rang lugs su tsen gyis bzhag /gnyis su mi bya/ phyag rgya chen po gnyis su med pa yin/ gnyis su snang ba thams cad ma rig pas rgyu byas nas 'khrul pa sna tshogs su byung ba yin/ mdor na phyag rgya chen po blo'i dri ma dang bral bar bsgom gsungs/ las dang po pa thun chung la grangs mang bar bya/ de ltar rgyun du ma yengs par bsgoms pas/ nyams rnal 'byor bzhi yang rim gyis 'char/ snang sems gnyis su med pa yis rkyen gyis mi gnod cing*/ 'khor 'das kyi yon tan thams cad rang la tshang bar yod gsung*/ gsang sngags kyi sgor zhugs pa rnams kyis/ rlung gnad du bsnun pa yang gal che/ rlung bzung na sems zin nas 'ong*/ sems kyi bzhon pa rlung yin par rgyud las gsungs/ rlung sems gnyis su med pa yin no// bla ma'i gsung sgros 'di bris pas// 'di bzhin nyams su blangs nas ni// rang gzhan don rnams 'grub par shog /bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs par shog/ //bla ma la rin po che'i zhal nas/ gnyug ma dang lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi khyad gang zhe na/ lhan cig skyes sbyor ni rtog pa lam du 'khyer te/ rtog pa la gnyis/ bzang rtog dang ngan rtog go /gang byung yang sku drin du shes pas rtog pa lam du byed pas/ 'khor bar 'khyams pa ni rnam par rtog pa ngo ma shes pas 'khyams te/ de ni rtog pa lam du byed pas 'khor ba la nyam nga med do// gnyug ma na re/ khyod kyis rtog pa lam du khyer bas/ gcad bya dang gcod byed gnyis (48na)su bzung nas rtog pa la zad pa med de/

rtog pa gcig byung ba de ngo shes par byas/ yang cig byung ba de yang ngo shes par byas kyang*/ ngo bo ma mthong na des go ma chod/ mthong rgyu gcig 'byung na de rang yin/ gzhan mthong rgyu med/ nga ma mthong na rtog pa la zad pa med pas khyod kyi de la thug pa med pa'i skyon yod/ nga ni dang po skye ba med pa yin/ bar du gnas pa med pa yin/ tha ma 'gag pa med pa yin/ ngo bo ngos bzung dang bral ba yin/ rang bzhin rgyun chad med pa yin/ mtshan nyid blo las 'das pa yin/ da ni gsang sngags kyi dbang du byas nas mtshan ma'i ngos nas bltas na/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyis kyang gzigs par mi 'gyur/ mtshan med kyi ngos nas bltas na dus thams cad du rgyun chad med pa yin/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i dbang du byas na/ nga la bsal bya ci yang med// bsnan par bya ba cung zad med// yang dag nyid la yang dag blta// yang dag mthong na rnam par grol// de la yang dag ni nga'o// yang sngags kyi ngo bo nges tshig dbye ba gsum mo// de la ngo bo ni skye ba med pas sangs rgyas kyi thugs yin te// de yang cis shes na/ saṃ bu ṭi las/ skye med rang bzhin sngags yin te// sngags kyi nges pa ci yang med// ces pa'o// nges tshig ni yid skyob pa ste/ de yang gsang ba 'dus pa las/ ma na yid trā ya skyob pa'o// dbye ba ni/ rtog pa'i sngags dang*/ rang rig pa'i sngags dang*/ brda'i sngags so// dang po rtog pa'i sngags ni kun btags khong gi rlung dang*/ gzhan dbang dag tu smra ba 'byung ba'o// gnyis pa rang rig pa'i sngags ni skye mched 'od gsal lo// gsum pa brda'i sngags ni (48ba)gzungs sngags mtha' dag dang*/ bskyed rim mtha' dag go /de la mgo can dang*/ mtha' can dang*/ sbrul lta bu dang*/ yi ge bsdus pa'o// de yang gsang ba 'dus pa las/ thog mar oṃ bstan tha mar swā hā med pa ni/ yi ge mgo can zhes bshad do// thog mar oṃ med tha mar swā hā ldan pa ni/

yi ge mtha' can zhes bshad do// thog mar oṃ med tha mar swā hā med pa ni/ yi ge bsdus pa zhes bshad do// thog mar oṃ yod tha mar swā hā yod pa ni/ sprul te zhi ba'i las can no// zhes so// //yang rin po che'i zhal nas/ sgrub pa po gcig gis bsgrubs pas/ rang gi rgyud la yon tan byung ba'i stobs kyis/ slob ma dad pa can dang phrad nas de la chos bshad pas/ sgrub pa po de lar rang tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas rgyu de phyir nur nas 'gro ba yin te/ de la ni dngos grub kyi sgo yal zer ba yin/ de bas na dka' gdams pa'am kha cig gis/ lkog rgyugs byas zer tsam na/ mis ma tshor bar don grub pa yod pa'am/ yang rang la nus pa yod na/ slob ma skal ba dang ldan pa ni rang gi srog la bab kyang skyong dgos par bshad do// yang sgrub pa po la rlangs pa phyir la shor bya ba yod de/ de ni sgrub pa po rang la yon tan zhig skye bas te/ phyi zang zing gi 'du 'dzi ru song nas/ sgrub pa'i bar chad du 'gyur ba yod/ spyir yang bsod nams zer ba'i 'du 'dzi 'di yang bdud kyi las su bshad pa yin gsung ngo*// yang rin po che'i zhal nas/ spyir bsgom pa la gol sa mang yang*/ khams gsum dang bsam gtan bzhi dang*/ skye mched bzhi la sogs pa gol sar bshad pa ni/ 'dzin pa bag tsam la brten nas gol ba yin/ nyan thos su gol ba de bcad pa'i stong pa la gnas (49na)pas gol ba yin/ ngo bo 'dzin med du gnas nas des na gang du yang gol sa med gsung*/ nyams dang rtogs pa gnyis su shor ba yang*/ nyams ni bde gsal la mchog 'dzin du song bas shar ba yin/ rtogs pa ni nyams kyi rgyun la chad par 'dzin pas nor ba yin te/ shor sa gnyis yin gsung*// //mi rtog pa dang ye shes dang stong pa dang gsum ni/ mi rtog pa ni rtog pa dang bral ba la bya/ ye shes ni sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa 'od gsal ba/ ye nas yod pa ngo shes pa'o// stong pa ni de nyid ngos bzung dang bral ba'o// shes pa shes bya shes rab gsum ni/

shes pa ni rang rig pa'i ngo bo// shes bya ni blo'i yul du gyur ba'i chos thams cad/ shes rab ni de nyid rtogs par byed pa'o// mi dmigs pa/ stong pa/ mtshan ma/ gsum ni/ stong pa nyams su myong ba'am/ mtshan ma la gang yang mi dmigs pa ni mi dmigs pa'o// phyi gzung ba'i yul yang gzhi rtsa ma grub/ nang 'dzin pa'i sems kyang gzhi rtsa ma grub pa ni stong pa'o// gzung ba dang 'dzin par bcas pa ni mtshan ma'o// chos zab pa dang*/ mi zab pa 'bring po gsum ni/ mi zab pa ni rgyu dge mi dge yod par bzung ba las/ 'bras bu bde ba dang sdug bsngal yod par myong nas/ las 'bras la yid ches pa ni mi zab pa'o// 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad yod ma myong*/ re zhig rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur shes pa ni 'bring po'o// zab pa ni gnyug ma ste/ rgya mtsho dang 'dra gting mi rnyed pas zab pa'o// sems dang sems can sems nyid gsum ni/ sems ni ngar 'dzin gyi rig pa'o// sems can ni sems can (49ba)thams cad do// sems nyid ni rgyun chad med pa'i chos sku'o// rgyu lam 'bras bu gsum ni/ skyed par byed pas na rgyu/ 'phel bar byed pas na lam/ rdzogs par byed pas na 'bras bu'o// de yang mar gyi dbang du byas na/ rgyu ma rig pa las sdig pa/ sdig pa chung ngu las chen por 'phel bas 'bras bu ngan song gsum mo// yar gyi dbang du byas na/ pha rol tu phyin pa ni rgyu rig pa byang chub kyi sems/ lam pha rol tu phyin pa drug /yang na lam bslab pa gsum/ 'bras bu sku gsum/ gsang sngags ni rgyu rig pa byang chub kyi sems/ lam bskyed rdzogs gnyis/ 'bras bu sku gsum mo// //'chi ba bsgoms pas tshe 'di'i don mi byed/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsgoms pas 'khor bar mi skye/ las dang 'bras bu bsgoms pas ngan song du mi skye/ byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgoms pas nyan thos dang rang rgyal bar mi skye/

chos zab mo stong pa nyid bsgoms pas gzugs med kyi khams su mi skye/ 'chi ba bsgoms pa la phan yon gsum/ yon tan lnga yod de/ skyo ba skye ba yin/ dad pa gso ba yin/ brtson 'grus kyi lcag tu gyur pa yin/ 'jig rten pa la mi chags pa yin/ mya ngan las 'das pa la mngon du phyogs pa yin/ 'chi ba bsgoms pa la rab 'bring gsum yod de/ rab kyis dngos po zhag tu mi 'dzin/ 'bring zla bar mi 'dzin/ tha mas lor mi 'dzin pa'o// //bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku// snang ba lhan cig skyes pa chos sku'i 'od// sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa ni/ sems kyi rang bzhin nam ngo bo de yin/ snang ba lhan cig skyes pa ni/ (50na)de las byung ba'i rnam par rtog pa de yin/ de yang nyi ma dang nyi ma'i 'od bzhin nam/ tsan+dan dang tsan+dan gyi dri lta bu yin/ de la rtogs par bya ba'i chos gsum dang*/ nyams su blang ba'i chos gsum ni/ snang ba lhan cig skyes pa ci yang ma yin pa la snang ba sna tshogs su shar ba rtogs par bya ba dang*/ sna tshogs su shar yang don la ci yang ma yin par rtogs par bya ba dang*/ gnyis su med pa smrar mi btub par shes par bya ba'o// de la nyams su blang ba'i chos gsum ni/ dang po sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa de la rtsol sgrub dang bral bas lus sems glod pa dang*/ bar du the tshom med par sems ma bcos pa so mar bzhag pa dang*/ tha mar byung tshor thams cad skye med du shes par bya'o// //lta sgom spyod pa gsum ni/ lta ba ma bcos pa gnyug ma'i shes pa/ sgom pa mi rtog pa tha mal gyi shes pa/ spyod pa ma zhen pa tshogs drug rgya yan lhug pa/ thabs ma yengs pa dran rtog rgyun chags so// de yang sangs rgyas dang sems can rgyu gcig /snang ba dang sems nyid tha mi dad/ gnyug ma'i rang bzhin de kho na nyid de/ byis pas ma shes snying po'i don la 'khrul/

bla ma rin po che'i gsung sgros dam pa/ slob dpon sgom chung la gdams pa'o// //nad zhi bar bya ba'i thabs la/ blo bcos pa'i thabs la gnyis te/ rjes su bzung ba dang tshar bcad pa gnyis so// rjes su bzung ba'i thabs la gnyis/ nad nyid thabs su 'khyer ba dang*/ shes rab kyis shes pa gzhan du 'khrid pa'o// nad thabs su 'khyer ba ni/ kun tu btags pa'i nad ni/ chos sam sgom ma yag pas nad du song ste/ khyed kyis ni nad med pa la nad du bzung (50ba)ste/ nad de la brten nas chos ma nor ba zhig dang phrad pa'i thabs yin/ chos ma nor bar rgyud la skye bar byed pa'i thabs kyang de yin/ 'bras bu myur du thob par byed pa'i thabs kyang de yin no// kho la de ltar bstan pas khos nad skyon du mi blta bar/ yon tan 'byung snyam nas nad la dad pas rang zhir 'gro /nad mi sos pa'i rtsa ba re dwogs gnyis yin te/ re bas 'gags/ dogs pas bsu ba la/ khos nad de nyid thabs su shes pas/ na yis dogs pa dang*/ sos su re ba med par zhen pas 'dzin pa btang bas/ nad rang zhir zhi/ 'dre'i gnod pa la yang de ltar bya/ rjes ni rjes su bzung ba'i tshul du bcos pa'o// rjes su bzung ba la lha'i byin rlabs tshul du yang 'khyer/ shes rab kyis blo gzhan du 'khrid pa'i tshul du blo sbyang ba ni/ blo nad la mi gnas par kho'i shes pa gar 'jug 'jug na phar 'khrid/ blo gzhan du yengs pas nad du 'dzin pa'i shes pa nyid shes rab tu ngo shes nas/ blo gar sgyur sgyur du btub pa chos nyid yin/ yang na blo tshar bcad pa'i sgo nas nad zhi bar bya ba yin te/ nad de rang gi thog tu nad rtsi tshi ba blo gar 'gro 'gro bsams pas/ sngar gyi nad zhi bar 'gyur ba chos nyid yin/ yang na nad nyid gang nas byung rtsad bcad pa dang*/ kha dog dang dbyibs la brtags pas nad kyang med de zhi nas 'gro ba chos nyid yin no// dang po dmigs pa dang rtsol bas mi 'jug

/bar du mi gnas/ tha mar mi 'dzin pa'o// lam 'di dang 'brel ba'i gang zag ni bzhi ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems chen po'i rigs la/ nyan thos kyi dus dang*/ rang gis ma rtogs pa bla ma la zhu dgos pa'i rigs la rang rgyal ba'i dus dang*/ gzhan pas kyang (51na)rang gis ltar rtogs dgos pa'i rigs la byang chub sems dpa'i dus dang*/ bdag gzhan gnyis ka'i don 'byung na/ byang chub sems dpa'i rigs bdag dang gzhan rgyud bsre nus na/ chen po dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i dus so// tshor ba gzugs khams/ bde ba/ tshor ba sdug 'dod khams/ bsngal ba/ tshor ba gzugs med khams la chags na'o// skyes sbyor chung ba'o/ btang snyoms so// //bla ma rin po che'i gsung sgros slob dpon sgom tshul gyis lha sar bzhugs dus su/ yol ba phyi gtam yang gsan no// slob dpon tshul khrims ye shes la gdams pa/ des bdag la// //gu ru na mo// bla ma sangs rgyas la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di thabs kyi mchog yin pas/ snying dang*/ khrag dang*/ rus pa'i gting nas/ mos gus drag po byas la/ ji ltar 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba 'debs dgos/ 'dis ni dam tshig la sel yod pa'i dgos pa yang skongs/ 'dod pa'i don thams cad dngos grub thams cad kyi rtsab yin/ kyang 'grub pa'o// 'dus byas kyi dge ba la bla ma la khyad par du gdams pa bka' bzhin du sgrub pa ni bsnyen bkur gyi mchog tu gsungs/ sangs rgyas su mthong nas gsol ba 'debs pa las bogs che ba'i chos gzhan med/ bla ma rin po che'i gsung ngo*// rang kho na gces par bzung nas/ rkyen ngan pa la sogs pa'o// en tsam re yang mi bzod par/ rma kha'i sha'u 'thogs pa 'dra/ rtag tu yus che ba nyon mongs pa thams cad la ngar 'dogs pa 'di yin/ rgyud la bdud la 'di las che ba ye med pas/ 'di ni rak+ṣa glang mgo dngos yin/ nga'i bsam pa kho nas 'bung ba yin gsung ngo*// yon tan skyer mi ster ba'i gegs chen (51ba)po yin/

rang gi nang du rlung 'tshubs pas bde ba thams cad 'joms pa'i tho bar yang 'dug /mtho sngon chad spyod pa 'di 'ba' zhig la bskyal bas rang mgo 'di mnan nas thar pa thob tu ma ster/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen gnya' gcag /dma' grog ma sbur bu yan chad phyogs su bcad nas/ rang kho na'i kha bzung bas 'khor ba las thar ram mi thar bsam dgos/ rgyud sbyangs pa dang*/ bsgoms pa'i dgos pa ni/ bdag dang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa yin/ phyi nang gi 'dod pa la skom pa chus gdungs pa lta bu bdud kyi las/ bla ma la gus par mi 'gyur ba bdud kyi las/ gdams pa la yid ches med cing rtsis med pa bdud kyi las/ ting 'dzin la gnas par mi byed cing rtag tu sems g.yengs ba bdud kyi las/ nga'o sems shing rang la gces par 'dzin pa bdud kyi las/ tshe 'di la zhen cing blo ma log pa bdud kyi las khyod kyi byad kyi dkyil na nag po zhig 'dug byas kyang mi dga' ba yin gsung*/ sngon chad kyang 'di kho nas 'khor bar bcings pa yin par go dgos// chen po'o// de las zlog pa'i thabs la 'bad pa ni/ nang gi 'dod pa'i snying po ni/ lcags kyi shal ma li la 'dzeg pa'am/ 'bras bu 'phra skam gyis 'don pa/ mdo nas gsung*/ dug ha la ha la ba bzhin du bsgom dgos/ phyi'i 'dod pa la ni/ sangs rgyas dang kun dga' bo'i gsung bzhin du bsgom dgos skad/ bla ma la mi gus pa'i gnyen por ni/ bla ma chos kyi

bla ma lnga bcu pa nas 'byung ba bzhin skyon la mi brtag yon tan la blta/ skur bsam zhing*/ snying thag pa rus pa'i gting nas gsol ba gdab bo// gdams ngag la yid mi ches pa'i gnyen por/ gdams ngag bdud rtsir bsam zhing rang nad par (52na)bsams la/ gdams ngag gi yon tan shes par bya'o// rang yus kyis rgyal ba'i gnyen por 'khor ba'i nad sel bar shes dgos/ rang la yon tan ci 'dug blta/ thams cad kyis khyod la gces par byed par 'chad pa la/ de bzhin du ma byung ba yin nam yang bsam/ ting nge 'dzin la mi gnas shing g.yengs pa'i gnyen por/ ting nge 'dzin ni bla ma yin/ ting nge 'dzin ni yid bzhin nor bu rin po che yin pas/ nyin ma yengs pa sangs rgyas kun gyi lam/ mtshan du yengs pa'i thabs med pa yin pas/ chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du bsgom/ blo log pa'i gnyen blo log ma log 'di la gnad che bar mdzad/ por ni/ 'khor ba'i sems can la bde skyid ci 'dug blta nyul thong*/ gtan yul ngan song gsum la byas mtho ris su 'gro ba don gnyer ba tsam zhig las ma myong gsung*/ rang gis sngon chad skyid sdug ci byas bsam/ rin po che ji skad gsung yang bsam 'tshal lo// lar snying rje zhig med na chos dus su mi rang gces par 'dzin pa ni thams cad la yod/ chos thams cad kyi rdor ram lan tshwa lta bu yin/ thon par shes pas/ byang chub kyi sems stong nyid dang bcas pa la 'bad 'tshal bar gda'o// //bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag rgya chen po rtogs par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis/ 'di ltar bsgom par bya ste/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku// snang ba lhan cig skyes pa chos sku'i 'od// 'khor 'das chos rnams rang bzhin mnyam par bsgom// nam mkha' lta bu'i chos 'di rtogs na yin// sems nyid kyi ngo bo de 'das pa'i rjes mi bcad/ ma 'ongs pa'i mdun mi bsu/ da lta ba gang du yang dmigs pa med par bzhag go

/de ltar bzhag pas sems (52ba)nyid kyi ngo bo gsal la rtog pa med pa nam mkha' rnam par dag pa'i dkyil lta bu 'byung ngo*// de yang yun ring ba la yon tan du mi blta/ thung ba la skyon du mi blta/ dus thams cad du de nyid ngang du ma yengs par bzhag go /skye med don la de ltar bsgoms gyur na// chos rnams thams cad gnyug ma'i ngang du 'char// chos rnams ro mnyam dus gsum rgyun par rtogs// de ltar don la ma yengs rgyun par zhog /phyag rgya chen po'i don de kho na nyid rnal du mtshon pa'i man ngag /dus gsum kun gyi sangs rgyas dgongs pa 'di/ bla ma grub thob rnams kyis rtogs gyur te/ 'gro ba sems can 'khor ba'i 'dam las sgrol gyur cig /bdag kyang phrin las bla ma dang mtshungs shog /ces gsungs pa'o// phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag rin po che'i sgron me/ khu dbon gsum gyi gsung sgros/ slob dpon sgom chung gis slob dpon stod lung pa la gdams// des bdag la gnang ngo*/// /bkra shis so/// /
